Lily and Ben were playing with crayons. They liked to draw on paper, but sometimes they also drew on other things. Lily saw a white shirt on the sofa. She thought it was boring. She wanted to make it more fun.

She took a red crayon and started to mark on the shirt. She made big circles and lines and dots. She smiled and said, "Look, Ben, I made a pretty shirt!"

Ben looked at the shirt and frowned. He knew it was not their shirt. It was Mom's shirt. She wore it to work. He said, "Lily, no! You can't mark on Mom's shirt! She will be mad!"

Lily did not listen. She kept marking on the shirt. She used more colors. She said, "No, Ben, it's fine. Mom will like it. It's a gift!"

Ben tried to stop her. He grabbed the shirt and pulled it. Lily pulled it back. They both tugged and twisted the shirt. They got dizzy and fell on the floor.

Mom came home and saw them. She saw the shirt. She was very mad. She said, "What did you do to my shirt? It's ruined!"

Lily and Ben looked at each other. They felt sorry. They said, "We're sorry, Mom. We wanted to make you a pretty shirt."

Mom sighed. She said, "I know you meant well, but you can't mark on things that are not yours. You have to ask first. And you have to use paper, not clothes. Do you understand?"

Lily and Ben nodded. They said, "We understand, Mom. We won't do it again."

Mom hugged them. She said, "I love you, but you have to be careful. Now, let's go and wash the shirt. Maybe we can save it."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He lived in a small house near a mysterious green cactus. Tom loved to play with his ball outside.

One sunny day, Tom went outside to play with his ball. He decided to throw the ball as far as he could. As he threw the ball, it flew high in the sky and landed near the mysterious cactus.

Tom went to get his ball, but he was scared of the cactus. He called out to his friend, Sam. "Sam, can you help me get my ball?" Sam came over and saw the ball near the cactus. He was brave and picked up the ball.

"Thank you, Sam!" Tom said with a big smile. They played together, throwing the ball far away from the mysterious cactus. They had lots of fun and played until the sun went down.

One day, a gray cat named Kitty went to a room with many shelves. Kitty liked to play and jump on the shelves. She saw a small box on the top shelf. Kitty thought it was a surprise for her.

Kitty jumped up to the top shelf to see the surprise. She opened the box and found a toy mouse inside. Kitty was very happy. She played with the toy mouse and had lots of fun.

Kitty's friend, Doggy, came into the room. Doggy saw Kitty playing with the toy mouse. Doggy said, "Wow, Kitty, what a fun surprise!" Kitty smiled and shared her toy mouse with Doggy. They played together and had a great day.

Mama was making dinner one night. She put a pot of water on the stove and started to heat it. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. She rushed to the kitchen and saw smoke coming out of the pot. Mama saw that her oyster had fallen in and started to burn!

Mama was very upset. She quickly grabbed the pot with her oven mitts and hurried outside. After it cooled down, Mama took the oyster out and threw it away.

Mama was still upset, but her little daughter couldn't understand what had happened. She asked with a curious voice, "Why is Mama upset?".

Mama smiled. She took her daughter's hand and said, "Well, my love, Mama burned an oyster. But don't worry, Mama fixed it". Then Mama hugged her daughter and everything was alright.

Bob was a guard. He had a wide hat and a big stick. He always watched the gates. One day Bob saw something and he felt sad. He wished he could have done something, but it was too late.

Bob didn't know what he had seen. But he felt like he had done something wrong. He was so sad he started to cry. He regretted what he had done.

Then one day, Bob saw something very special. It was a beautiful butterfly. Bob felt so happy that he stopped crying. He wanted to be a friend and guard the butterfly. So every day, Bob watched the butterfly and kept it safe.

Every day, Bob forgot about his regret and felt more and more happy. He was so happy to be a guard and look after the butterfly. This was all he wanted to do any more.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Billy and Liz. They were so excited to play together with their blocks. Billy had a big box of blocks. He tiped it upside down and the blocks tumbled out. 

Billy and Liz began to build a tower with the blocks. It was getting bigger and bigger and soon it was very tall. The blocks were tough so they stayed in place. 

Just then, the phone started to ring. Billy's mom was calling to check in. Billy stepped away from the blocks so he could answer the phone. 

When he came back to the tower, he saw that the blocks had toppled over. He and Liz laughed and decided to make the tower bigger than ever before. So they worked together to build it back up and soon it was even taller. 

When the tower was finished, they danced around it and sang a song. They had so much fun playing together with the blocks.

Once upon a time, there was a big gray elephant. He was very sad because he felt alone. He wanted to make friends with the other animals in the jungle, but they didn't want to play with him because he was too big.

One day, the elephant saw a monkey who was stuck in a tree. The elephant decided to help the monkey by using his big trunk to open the tree's branches. The monkey was very happy and grateful. He thanked the elephant and invited him to play with the other animals.

The elephant was nervous at first, but he decided to join them. The other animals were surprised to see the elephant, but they welcomed him with open arms. They played together and had lots of fun.

The moral of the story is that when we unite and help each other, we can make new friends and have fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, she went to the park with her mom. There, she saw a boy playing with a ball. She wanted to play with him, but she was too shy to ask.

Later, her mom took her to the ice cream truck. Lily saw the boy in line in front of her. She decided to request the same flavor as him. "I want the same as the boy in the blue shirt," she said to the ice cream man. The boy turned around and smiled at her.

As they sat and ate their ice cream, Lily asked the boy if he wanted to play with her. He said yes and they had so much fun together. They played tag and hide-and-seek. Before they left, the boy gave Lily his phone number and said they could play again soon.

Lily went home with a gentle smile on her face, happy to have made a new friend. She couldn't wait to call him and play again.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky lived in a pond with her friends, the fishies. One day, it rained a lot and the pond started to flood. Ducky got very scared and asked her fishy friends what to do.

One fishy said, "We need to yield to the flood and swim to higher ground!"

Ducky was very sleepy and didn't want to swim, but she knew she had to be brave. So, she followed her fishy friends and they swam to a nearby hill. 

But when they got there, they saw that the hill was already crowded with other animals who had also run away from the flood. They were all arguing about who should be allowed to stay. 

Ducky said, "Let's not fight. We can share the hill and all sleep here tonight."

Everyone agreed and they all had a peaceful night's sleep. The next day, the flood had gone down and they all went back to their homes in the pond, happy to be safe and sound. The end.

One day, a girl and her brother were playing in the yard. They found an interesting big box. The girl said, "Let's open it!" The brother nodded and said, "Yes, but we need to be careful." They ran inside to find something to help them open the box.

The girl found a small tool to cut. She showed it to her brother and said, "This will help us open the box." The brother smiled and said, "Let's go back outside and see what's inside." They went back to the yard and started to cut the box open.

As they cut the box, they found many colorful toys inside. They were so happy! They played with the toys all day. The girl and her brother knew that being careful and working together made the day even more fun. And that interesting big box brought them lots of joy.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Anna and Joe. They were playing together in the garden when Anna spotted something between the trees.

"Look Joe! Look what I found," she squealed. 

Joe ran over and saw a tiny skull. He felt helpless. 

"What is it, Anna?" he asked. 

"Don't worry, Joe," Anna said cheerfully. "It's just a skull. Let's twist it!"

So, they each grabbed one of the skull's big eyes and twisted it. 

The skull's head spun around, round and round! Anna and Joe laughed and laughed. 

"Let's do it again!" Anna said. So they twisted the skull's head again and again, until they had to go home. 

As they left, Anna and Joe felt happy. They had each made a new, special friend that day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pink dress and loved to play outside. One day, she saw a parrot in a tree. The parrot was also pink! 

Lily said to the parrot, "Hello, pretty bird! Do you want to swing with me?" 

The parrot said, "Yes, please!" So Lily put the parrot on the swing and pushed it gently. The parrot was very happy and chirped with joy. 

But then, a big gust of wind came and blew the parrot away. Lily was very sad and cried. She learned that sometimes, even when we are having fun, bad things can happen. It's important to be careful and keep our friends safe.

Once upon a time, there was a furry cat named Mittens. Mittens loved to play with her ball of yarn, but one day she got lost. Mittens didn't know how to get home, so she meowed very loud. She shouted and shouted, hoping someone would hear her message. 

Finally, a kind little girl heard Mittens' shouts and found her. The little girl picked up Mittens and brought her home. Mittens was so happy to be back with her family. From that day on, Mittens never wandered too far from home again.

Once upon a time, there was a poor little bird. The bird lived in a tree and had no food to eat. One day, the bird went to pick some seeds from the ground. But the bird was still hungry. Suddenly, the bird heard a beautiful sound. It was a little girl singing! The bird felt happy and started to sing too. The little girl saw the bird and gave it some bread to eat. The bird was not poor anymore and sang a happy song.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very hungry and wanted to eat some cake. But his mommy was not at home, and he didn't know how to use a fork. He tried to eat the cake with his hands, but it was too messy.

Suddenly, he saw a big truck zoom by. It was carrying lots of cakes. Timmy thought it would be fun to follow the truck. He ran after it, but he didn't look both ways and crossed the street without looking. 

It was very dangerous, and a car hit him. Timmy got hurt very badly and had to go to the hospital. The moral of the story is that it's important to always look both ways before crossing the street.

Once there was a big lion who always wanted to explore the world. He had never seen anything outside of his forest. One day, he decided to find a new home. 

He started by walking through the woods and then came to a large clearing. In the center of the clearing was a modern city with bright lights. The lion was so amazed that it let out a huge roar.

The noise scared some people who were walking near by. One of them, a little girl, was so frightened that she started to cry.

The lion was embarrassed and said to her, "It's okay, I'm sorry I roared. I'm looking for a new home, would you help me?"

The little girl smiled, dried her tears and nodded. She held his paw and guided him around the city. Everywhere they went, the lion marveled at the bright lights and modern homes. In the end, the lion chose a new home and all thanks to the little girl. She was his new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a man and a lady who liked each other very much. They wanted to be together forever, so they decided to marry. 

On the day of their wedding, the lady brought a drum. She said it was a present for the man. It was the most brilliant drum that anyone had ever seen! It shone in a bright yellow colour and had a beautiful pattern on it. 

The man and the lady were so happy that they hugged and kissed each other. Then the man played a song on the drum. It was the best song anyone had ever heard. 

They danced together to the song and laughed and smiled so much that it made everyone else happy too. 

The man and the lady had a brilliant day when they married. They were together forever, and it was all thanks to the wonderful drum!

Joe was envious of his older brother, Zac. Zac was so good at math and Joe wanted to be like him. One day, Zac made Joe a promise. He said that if Joe studied math every day he would get better at it. Joe was so excited and he did his best to study every day.

One time, Zac had a test and Joe was really nervous. But Joe was happy when Zac came home with a big smile on his face. Zac had gotten a good mark on his test because of all the math he had studied. Joe was so proud of him.

Eventually, Joe started to get better and better at math everyday. He forgot all about being envious of Zac because he was learning so much. Now both brothers are great at math and they have even started helping each other to study!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He had a cool toy car that he loved to play with. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy saw Timmy's toy car and wanted to play with it too.

Timmy didn't want to share his toy car because he thought Billy might break it. Billy got upset and started to cry. Timmy felt bad and started to think about what he could do to make Billy feel better.

Then, Timmy had an idea. He suggested they play with Billy's cool toy truck instead. Billy was happy again and they had fun playing together. Timmy learned that sometimes sharing is a cool thing to do and it makes everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Claire. Claire was three years old and she loved to sell things. One day, she decided to take a march around the neighborhood to see if she could sell something.

Claire started marching up and down the street, and soon she noticed an old man sitting on a bench. She stopped and walked up to him.

"Hello!" said Claire enthusiastically. "Do you want to buy something?"

The old man smiled. "Well, what are you selling?" he asked.

"I'm selling these," said Claire, holding up her tray of cupcakes.

The old man's eyes lit up. "They look delicious," he said. "I'll take five of them."

Claire smiled and handed him the cupcakes. She gave him a serious look and said, "That'll be five dollars, please."

The old man chuckled and handed over the money. Claire thanked him and she started marching away, feeling very proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there lived two best friends, Daisy and Emily. Daisy and Emily loved going to the gym together. 

On one sunny afternoon, Daisy and Emily entered the gym. Emily whispered, "Let's go and play with the balls." Daisy happily said, "Yes!" 

They grabbed some balls and went to a calm corner. "Let's play catch!" Daisy said, while gently throwing a ball to Emily. Emily smiled and threw the ball back to Daisy.

They continued playing until they heard a clap. Looking around, they saw Daisy's mom standing near the door. "Come on Daisy, time to go home," she said softly.

Emily and Daisy hugged eachother as Daisy waved goodbye and left. "See you tomorrow," Emily whispered. 

And so every day, Daisy and Emily would go to the gym and whisper secrets to eachother whilst playing catch with the balls.

Once there was a little girl named Sally. She was very eager to go see the big city. One day Sally's mom and dad took her to the city. It was really cool! 

The first thing Sally saw was a big hill with a park on top. She wanted to roll downhill on the grass. So Sally ran up the hill and rolled down it over and over until she was tired. It was so much fun! 

Next, they went to the city center. Sally could see all the tall buildings and the busy streets. She liked to see all the different people. Sally's parents bought her an ice cream and she ate it while strolling through the city. 

Sally was so happy to be in the city. She waved at all the passersby and smiled. The day was so nice and the city was so exciting. 

When it was time to go home, Sally said goodbye to the city with a big smile on her face. She was already eager to come back and roll down the big hill again!

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a baby. The mommy put the baby in a bag. The bag was normal. It was soft and warm, and the baby liked to be inside it. 

The mommy said to the baby, â€œLetâ€™s wrap up the bag! Are you ready?â€ 

The baby smiled and said, â€œYes!â€ 

So the mommy wrapped up the bag and tied it with a ribbon. The baby felt snug and comfy inside the bag. 

The mommy said, â€œNow you look like a present! Letâ€™s go give the bag to Grandma.â€ 

The baby giggled and said, â€œOk!â€ 

And the mommy and baby set off to give the bag to Grandma. Everyone was surprised to find the baby in the bag, but they all hugged her and said, â€œWhat a beautiful present!â€ 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old. One day, Sarah saw a big stair. It was very tall. She wanted to go up the stair, but it was so high. She looked scared.

Suddenly, a voice came from behind her.

"Sarah, what's wrong?" it asked.

Sarah turned around. It was her mom.

"Mom," Sarah said, "The stair is so high. I am scared."

Her mom smiled and said, "It's OK, Sarah. You can do it. Just take it one step at a time and be safe."

Sarah smiled and nodded. She took a deep breath and started walking up the stair. Every step, she said to herself "safe, safe, safe."

Finally, she made it to the top. She looked around and asked, "Mom, did I do it?"

Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, Sarah. You did it! You were very brave."

Sarah was very happy and proud of herself. She knew that she could do it if she was safe!

Tim and Liz were playing by the river. They saw a big raft made of wood and rope. They wanted to go on it and have fun.

"Can we go on the raft, please?" Tim asked his mom.

"Okay, but be careful. Don't go too far and wear your life jackets," mom said.

Tim and Liz put on their life jackets and climbed on the raft. They used sticks to push the raft along the water. They saw ducks, fish and frogs. They laughed and sang.

Suddenly, the raft hit a rock and started to spin. Tim and Liz were scared and confused. They did not know what to do. They held on to the raft and each other.

"Help! Help!" they shouted.

Mom heard them and ran to the river. She saw the raft spinning and her children crying. She threw a rope to them and pulled them to the shore.

"Are you okay?" mom asked.

"Yes, we are okay. But we are dizzy and wet," Tim said.

"I'm sorry, mom. We did not mean to spin the raft," Liz said.

"It's okay, my loves. I'm glad you are safe. Next time, be more careful and stay away from the rocks," mom said.

She hugged them and took them home. They had some hot chocolate and cookies. They learned their lesson and never spun the raft again.

Once upon a time, there was a large elephant named Ellie. Ellie loved to play in the mud and roll around in it. One day, Ellie's mom said, "Ellie, it's time to wash up!" 

Ellie didn't want to wash because she loved feeling muddy. But her mom said, "You need to wash, or else you'll get sick." 

Ellie stomped her feet and said, "No, I don't want to wash! I want to stay muddy!" 

Her mom replied, "But Ellie, your friends won't want to play with you if you're all muddy. They might think you're a monster!" 

Ellie thought about it and realized her mom was right. She didn't want her friends to be scared of her. So, she reluctantly agreed to wash up. As she washed, she noticed the soap made a zigzag pattern on her skin. She giggled and said, "Look, Mom! Zigzag!" 

After she was all clean, Ellie felt much better. She hugged her mom and said, "Thanks for making me wash, Mom. I feel much better now!"

Once upon a time there was a girl. She was three years old and wanted to do something. Her goal was to perform. She thought it would be tough.

One day she decided it was time to practice. She looked around for something special to do. She found a big box of blocks. She took out some blocks and began to stack them up. She worked very hard and was so proud of herself.

But then the big tower of blocks toppled over! She let out a big sigh and wanted to give up. But she was tough and tried again. She kept trying one more time and finally the tower stayed up!

She had accomplished her goal. She had performed and she was so proud!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved fireworks because they were so bright and pretty. One day, Lily and her family went to see a big fireworks show. When the fireworks started to scatter in the sky, Lily clapped her hands with glee. 

As the night went on, Lily saw many different kinds of fireworks. Some were red, some were blue, and some were green. They all made loud noises and lit up the sky. Lily was so happy that she couldn't stop smiling. 

When the show was over, Lily went home with her family. She couldn't wait to tell her friends about the bright and beautiful fireworks she saw. From that day on, Lily loved fireworks even more and looked forward to seeing them again.

Once there was a wild number. It enjoyed travelling and exploring the world. One day, the number found itself on an island and it noticed that it had no fuel to get off. It was very worried, so it decided to look around for some fuel. After a while, it noticed a big boat in the distance. It ran as fast as it could and was happy to find fuel inside. The number loaded the fuel onto its boat and sailed away. It had an amazing adventure and was glad that it found the fuel. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures with her family. One day, they decided to go on a treasure hunt. Lily's dad showed her a map with a big X on it. The map looked unusual because it had drawings of animals and trees on it.

Lily and her family followed the map to a big tree. Her dad said, "I think the treasure might be buried under this tree." They started to dig and dig until they found a treasure chest. Inside the chest, they found gold coins and shiny jewels. Lily was so happy that she hugged her family.

Later that day, Lily said to her mom, "I want to be a treasure hunter when I grow up." Her mom smiled and said, "You can be anything you want to be, Lily." From that day on, Lily kept the map and treasure chest as a reminder of their exciting adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to eat candy. One day, Timmy's mom bought him a big bag of candy. Timmy was so happy and he opened the bag right away. But when he looked inside, he saw that there was a soldier toy in the bag too.

Timmy didn't like the soldier toy and he wanted to throw it away. But then he remembered that his friend Billy loved soldiers. So, Timmy decided to give the soldier to Billy. But when Timmy gave the soldier to Billy, Billy didn't want it either. Billy said that his dad was a soldier and he didn't like toys that looked like soldiers.

Timmy didn't know what to do. He wanted to eat his candy and forget about the soldier toy, but he didn't want to be mean to Billy. Finally, Timmy had an idea. He asked Billy if he could trade the soldier toy for some of Billy's candy. Billy agreed and they both went home happy.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty bear. He was strong and brave - the strongest bear in the whole wood. He was so mighty, that every day he would go out and find treats for himself. One day, as he was roaming around, he suddenly realized he had lost his treats! He was very sad and couldn't think of what to do.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was a small voice, but it called out to him: "Mighty Bear, don't be sad - I know where the treats are!" The bear was so excited - he followed the voice until he finally found what he was looking for: the treats! He was so happy that his treats were back, he hugged the little voice and thanked them.

It was then that the bear realized the tiny voice belonged to a little mouse! The mouse had found the bear's treats, and wanted to help the bear by letting him know. The bear was so grateful that he thanked the mouse for being so kind, and offered to share his treats with the mouse too. 

The two new friends shared the treats and from then on, they would always look out for each other, so that no one would ever have to lose their treats again.

Today, Lilly was playing in the park with a furry friend. She saw a group of children playing tag and was eager to join them.

"Please let me play," Lilly shouted over to the group. 

One of the children replied, "You can join us if you can gain us." 

Lilly looked puzzled and asked, "Gain you? What do you mean?"

The children laughed and explained. "If you can catch us, then you can join us. Let's see if you can gain us!" 

Lilly agreed and the game began. She quickly ran to catch the children. After a few attempts, Lilly finally managed to gain them! She became part of the game and had lots of fun. 

The furry friend watched from the side happily, delighted to see Lilly's success.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and her teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, we are going to the park. Are you ready to go?" 

Lily was very excited and said, "Yes, Mommy! Let's go!" When they got to the park, Lily saw something different. There was a man kneeling on the ground, painting a picture. 

Lily went up to the man and said, "Hi! What are you doing?" The man smiled and said, "I am painting a picture of the trees and the flowers." 

Lily said, "Wow! That's so cool! Can I start painting too?" The man said, "Of course! Here is a paintbrush and some paint." 

Lily was so happy and started painting her own picture. When she was finished, she showed it to the man. He said, "That's a beautiful picture, Lily!" 

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you! I had so much fun painting with you!" And that's how Lily had a fun day at the park with a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Joe. He wanted to go on a grand adventure, but he needed something to help him.

He found a box with a lock on it. He tried to unlock it, but it was too hard for him.

Joe asked his mom for help. His mom told him that if he helped around the house, she would unlock the box for him. Joe was excited!

He quickly got to work, cleaning the dishes, tidying the toys and making his bed. After he had done this, his mom came back with a key. She unlocked the box for Joe.

When he opened it, Joe was so impressed! Inside was a beautiful set of new clothes! He quickly put them on and started exploring the world, on a grand adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, she was playing with her dolls when she heard a fierce noise outside. She went to the window and saw a big truck driving by.

Lily asked her mommy, "What is that noise?" Her mommy said, "That's a truck, Lily. It's carrying things from one place to another." Lily listened and heard the sound of the truck getting quieter as it drove away.

Later that day, Lily was playing with her mommy's nail polish. She accidentally spilled it on the carpet. Her mommy said, "Oh no, Lily! You spilled the nail polish. We need to clean it up." Lily helped her mommy clean the nail polish off the carpet.

As they were cleaning, Lily asked her mommy, "What does fierce mean?" Her mommy said, "Fierce means something that is very strong and powerful. Like a lion is fierce." Lily listened and learned a new word.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to climb trees in the park. One day, she saw a big tree and she wanted to climb it. She started climbing and climbing until she reached the top. She was so happy and proud of herself.

After climbing the tree, she felt hungry. She went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, I want some food." Her mommy gave her a sandwich and some fruit. Lily ate everything and felt very full. 

Later that day, Lily accidentally broke her mommy's vase. Her mommy was very angry and scolded her. Lily felt sad and apologized to her mommy. Her mommy forgave her and gave her a big hug. From then on, Lily knew not to climb trees near the vase.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a dull day because it was raining outside. Lily was feeling sad because she wanted to play in the park with her friends. 

Lily's mom noticed that she was sad and asked her, "What's wrong, Lily?" Lily replied, "I want to play outside, but it's raining. I'm suffering because I'm bored." 

Her mom thought for a moment and said, "I have an idea. Let's have a picnic under the table!" Lily's face lit up with excitement and she said, "That sounds like fun!" 

So, they had a picnic under the table with sandwiches and juice. They played games and sang songs. Lily forgot about the rain and had a great time. She realized that even though it was raining outside, she could still have fun under the table with her mom.

Charlie was a curious boy. He liked to go outside and explore the world. One day, Charlie saw a tall cloud in the sky. He wanted to know what it was like to balance on a cloud. He was excited and he wanted to try it.

So, he thought of a plan. He ran to the park and found a big ladder he could use. He carried it over to the cloud and carefully placed it against the cloud. He started climbing the ladder, higher and higher towards the top of the tall cloud.

He was a little bit scared, but he kept climbing. When he reached the top, he was surprised to find out that the cloud was a fluffy, soft cushion! He lay down safely on the top of the cloud and balanced there.

He opened his arms wide, looked around and smiled. It was a magical feeling! He lay there for a while, floating around in the sky until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a young bird. It had just hatched from its egg and was very delicate. Its mommy bird took care of it and taught it how to fly. The young bird felt very happy when it finally learned how to fly.

One day, the young bird saw a big and juicy worm on the ground. It felt very hungry and wanted to eat the worm. But the mommy bird warned it that the worm might be dangerous. The young bird didn't listen and ate the worm anyway.

After a while, the young bird started to feel sick. It regretted not listening to its mommy bird. It realized that it should have been more careful and not eaten something that looked suspicious. From then on, the young bird promised to always listen to its mommy bird and be more careful in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink milk every day. Her mommy always poured her a tall glass of milk, but Lily wanted it even higher. She would say, "Mommy, can you make the milk go up to the sky?"

One day, Lily and her mommy were baking a cake for her daddy's birthday. They needed to split the eggs into two bowls. Lily was so excited to help, but she accidentally dropped one of the eggs on the floor. Her mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can clean it up together."

As they were cleaning up the egg, Lily noticed that the milk was starting to rise higher and higher in the glass. She said, "Mommy, look! The milk is going up to the sky!" Her mommy smiled and said, "That's because we added a special ingredient to the cake. It makes the milk rise high in the glass." 

When the cake was finished baking, they put candles on it and sang "Happy Birthday" to Lily's daddy. He blew out the candles and they all enjoyed a slice of the delicious cake with their tall glasses of milk. Lily was so happy that she got to help make the cake and see the milk go up high in her glass.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She had lots of stuff. Every day she would get new things, and she loved to count them. She counted everyday things like spoons and books, but also strange, special things like feathers from a bird and a shell from the beach.

One day, her mommy decided it was time to go on an adventure. They went deep into the woods. Everywhere they looked, they saw new things. The girl was so excited to count all the new stuff that she found. She found bugs, leaves and twigs...she counted and counted and counted! 

They got deeper and deeper into the woods. The girl was having a great time, so she kept counting until...she reached the deepest part of the woods. There, they discovered something really special - a beautiful lake full of fish. The girl was amazed. She loved counting all the fish swimming around. 

When it was time to go home, the girl said goodbye to the lake with a heavy heart. She knew she'd be back soon. After all, she still had lots of stuff to count!

Once upon a time, there was a generous pigeon. Everywhere she went, she tried to help animals by sharing some of her food. All the other animals welcomed her with a smile.

But one day, the pigeon had eaten all of her food. She was very hungry and had nowhere to go. Then, she heard a voice in the distance. It was an old fox. 

The fox said, "I will give you some food, dear pigeon if you help me with a task I have. I need you to collect some stones that are lying around my den. Can you help me?"

The generous pigeon happily agreed to help the fox. Once she had collected the stones, the fox gave her a feast of food to eat.

The moral of the story: If you are generous and helpful to others, you will be rewarded.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful purple daisy. Every day the daisy would stand in the same spot, smiling in the sun. Suddenly, one day, a little girl named Molly enter the garden. She saw the magical purple daisy standing in the field and she could not believed her eyes. 

Molly ran to the daisy and asked, "Where did you come from?" The daisy was shy and did not reply. So, Molly asked again, a bit more softly this time, "Do you want to be my friend?"

The daisy brightened, happy to hear these words. She asked, "Will you take care of me?" Molly promises she would take great care of the daisy every day. 

The moral of the story is that if you take care of something good and pure, it will bring you great joy.

Once upon a time, there was a rich boy called Jack. Jack wanted to keep some lightning in his house.

So he went to find some. On his way, he met some friendly animals who were more than happy to show him where he could find some lightning.

But once he got to the place of the lightning, there was so much of it that Jack couldn't keep it all. He looked at the animals with a sad face and said: "I can't keep so much. What should I do?" 

The animals thought for a while and then one of them said: "You can take a little bit each time. That way, you can keep some lightning, and it will last much longer than if you try to carry it all in one go."

Jack thanked the animals and did as they said. He kept some of the lightning in his house and was very happy. From that moment on, every time Jack needed some lightning, he knew just where to get it!

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy. The mommy wanted to give her baby a special gift. She decided to provide her little one with a shoulder to lean on.

The mommy said to her baby, â€œNo matter what, I will always be available for you to lean on.â€

The baby smiled and hugged her mommy. Then the mommy placed two hands on the babyâ€™s shoulders and said, â€œWhenever you need me, I am here for you. You can always lean on me.â€

The baby was so happy to receive this special gift from her mommy. From that day forward, the mommy and the baby had a special bond. No matter what, the mommy was always available and the baby always had a shoulder to lean on.

Once upon a time there were two best friends who did everything together. They were Tom and Joe. Tom was very excited because he had just made some new pants. He was so proud of them! He showed them to Joe. They were thick and warm and perfect for the cold weather.

Joe was so excited that Tom made the pants. He asked Tom if he could make him a pair too. Tom happily agreed and Joe used his favorite colorful fabric to make the pants for Joe. 

After the pants were finished, the two boys wore them and went outside to play in the snow. The pants were perfect! The thick fabric kept them nice and warm so they could play all day.

Tom and Joe had so much fun in their new pants! They ran, they laughed and they played until it was time to go inside. Now they wear their warm, thick pants all the time - they even wear them to bed sometimes!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the beach with her family. One day, they went to the beach and her mom gave her a bucket to collect seashells. Lily was so excited to find a lot of seashells.

While she was walking along the shore, she saw a little shrimp. "Oh, you are so cute!" she said. She picked up the shrimp and put it in her bucket with the seashells. But soon, Lily noticed a smelly odor coming from her bucket.

"What is that smell?" her brother asked.

"I don't know," Lily said, "but it's coming from my bucket."

Suddenly, Lily's brother saw the shrimp in the bucket. "I think that shrimp is making the smell," he said.

Lily realized that the shrimp was not a good thing to keep in her bucket. She took it out and put it back in the ocean. From that day on, Lily never lost a shrimp in her bucket again.

Once upon a time, there lived a fierce dragon who always liked to listen. One day, he heard about a beautiful rainbow which lived far away. The dragon was so excited that he decided to go look for the rainbow. He flew and he flew until he reached the rainbow. He was ready to listen.

When the dragon arrived, he saw the beautiful rainbow. But what he didn't see was the fierce storm coming his way. The storm grew bigger and bigger and before the dragon knew it, the sky was full of thunder and lightning. The dragon was so scared.

The dragon tried to fly away, but the winds were so strong that he couldn't move. The rain started to fall, and the dragon hid under a tree. He wanted to listen more but he was too afraid. The storm grew stronger and stronger, until it finally ended.

The dragon was so sad. He wanted the rainbow more than ever, but it was gone now. All that was left were the fierce storm clouds and the sad dragon.

Once there was a family who loved to go on trips. Every time they went away, they had to pack their bags.

One day, the family packed their bags and drove to a new place. When they arrived, they heard a strange noise. It was really loud and really scary.

The family was so scared they wanted to leave right away. But they didn't know what the noise was.

So the dad said, "Let's get out of here, but first let's find out what is making that noise."

So the family searched everywhere. Finally, they found the source of the noise. It was a family of birds living in an old tree. The birds were chirping so loudly the family could hear them from far away.

The family were relieved and laughed at the silly noise the birds were making. They stayed a bit longer and then packed their bags and went home.

Once upon a time there was a clever little bird. Every day at noon the bird would fly over to the pond to drink some water. When he got to the pond he spotted another clever bird that was already drinking.

The two birds looked at each other for a moment, until the first bird made a funny sound. The second bird began to giggle and the two of them started making funny noises together.

After a while of trying to make each other laugh, the two birds remembered they were thirsty and went back to drinking. After they had their fill, they said goodbye and went off in different directions until noon the next day.

Once upon a time, there was an impatient little boy. He had to close the door each time his mom asked him to. 
It was the law in his house. He didn't like closing the door, but he had to. One day, he tried to find a way around the law. But his mom was watching, and she said he must close the door.

So, the little boy sadly closed the door. Then, he had an idea. He asked his mom if he could wear a cape and play like he was a super hero. His mom said yes and he put on his cape.

The little boy was no longer impatient. Instead, he eagerly went to close the door each time. He thought of himself as a super hero who kept his house safe by making sure the door was always closed. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a jar. It was a white jar. She was very happy with it.

One day, another girl saw the white jar. She wanted it very much. When the first girl said no, the other girl became very angry. She started to hate the first girl.

The angry girl then started to shout and she hit the white jar with her hand. She made a big hole in it. The first girl was very sad. Now she could not use her white jar anymore.

The two girls never spoke again. The first girl was sad and she really hated the other girl for destroying her white jar.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man. He woke up in the morning and looked up at the sky. The sky was as blue as could be and it made the man happy. 

He decided to go for a walk. He went to the park, and there was an empty pitch. He sat down and watched the birds  rising in the sky. They were so pretty and graceful. He was mesmerized by their beauty.

Suddenly, he felt something shift underneath him. What was it? The pitch was rising! He could not believe his eyes! He got up and saw that the pitch had risen to a more comfortable level. He was so happy and couldn't believe his luck.

The bald man sat down and looked up at the sky once more. He was so astonished by his luck. He thanked God for this miracle and decided to never forget it. He would always remember the rising pitch and the birds soaring in the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a sad little girl who had lost her chalk. Everywhere she looked, she couldn't find it. She looked in the toy box, in the closet, and everywhere else. But the chalk was gone.

The little girl asked her mom, "Mommy, have you seen my chalk?"

But her mom said, "No, I'm sorry dear, I haven't seen your chalk."

The little girl was very sad. She went outside to look for her chalk. As she was looking, she saw a bad man. He was carrying her chalk! He had stolen it!

The little girl asked the bad man, "Please give me back my chalk!"

But the bad man just laughed. He stuffed the chalk into his pocket and ran away.

The little girl was very sad. She started to cry.

The little girl never saw her chalk again.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a boy and a girl. They liked to draw pictures together. One day, the boy drew a picture that the girl liked very much. She felt jealous because she wanted to draw a picture like that too. 

The girl started to quarrel with the boy. She said that his picture was not good and that hers was better. The boy felt sad because he thought his picture was good. 

But then, the girl said sorry and they became friends again. They decided to draw a picture together. This time, they drew a picture of them holding hands and smiling. It was the best picture they had ever drawn!

Once upon a time there was an old man who was very poor. He didn't have much money, but he was very kind.

One day, the old man saw a strange thing. A big frozen lake that hadn't been there before. He wanted to see what was inside, so he decided to walk over to it.

When he got to the lake, he saw a little creature inside. It was a snowman! He was stuck in the ice and couldn't get out.

The old man didn't know how to help the snowman, so he decided to wait. He waited for hours until finally, the sun came out and the ice started to melt.

The snowman was free! The old man was so happy that he could help the little creature. The snowman thanked him and the old man was filled with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to ride his scooter in the park. One day, Timmy saw a dangerous puddle on the path. He didn't want to ride through it and get wet. Suddenly, he saw a frog stuck in the puddle! 

Timmy knew he had to save the frog. He carefully picked up the frog and put him on his scooter. He rode the scooter all the way to the pond and let the frog go. The frog was happy and Timmy felt proud that he saved him. 

From that day on, Timmy always looked out for dangerous things on his scooter rides. He knew that he could be a hero and save other animals too. Timmy and his scooter became famous in the park for being the best animal savers around.

Once there was a little girl who was 3. She was walking in a park when she saw a palm tree. She was excited and moved closer. But then she saw something blue at the base of the tree. She moved even closer and saw that it was a bird. The bird was stuck in a bush and she could tell he was scared.

The little girl wanted to help him so she tried to move the bush but it felt too heavy. Even after she got her mom to come and help, the bush wouldn't move.

The little girl tried really hard to think of a way to help the bird. She moved around the bush, looking from all angles, when she spotted a hole. Through the hole she could see the scared blue bird.

The little girl ran and grabbed a stick and tried to move the twigs away from the hole. When she was done, the bird was free! The little girl smiled and hugged the little bird, and the bird flew away. The little girl was so happy that she could help the scared blue bird.

Once upon a time, there was a very foolish cat, who liked to cause all kinds of trouble. One day, he stirred up a nest of bees, and they all flew out, buzzing angrily. But the cat didn't want to get stung, so he asked the dog near by if there was a way to solve his problem.

The dog thought for while and then said, "If you find something soft and velvety, then the bees won't be able to sting you. I have a blanket that might do the trick!"

The cat was so relieved and he thanked the dog. He quickly grabbed the blanket and wrapped it around himself. The bees didn't have a way to get at him and they flew off, angry and confused. The cat was safe and the problem had been solved. 

The foolish cat thanked the dog again, and they went off together, looking for more adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. One evening, Timmy's mom asked him to eat his vegetables. Timmy refused and said he didn't like them. His mom was sorry that Timmy didn't like his vegetables, but she said he had to eat them to be healthy. Timmy still refused and started to cry. His mom hugged him and said she loved him, but he still had to eat his vegetables. Timmy finally agreed and ate his vegetables. He felt better and his mom was happy. The end.

One day, Jack and his family walked into the museum. Jack looked around in wonder--there were so many things to see! He saw a beautiful painting that glowed with colors and asked his mom what it was.

"That's a painting by a gifted artist," his mom explained. "It's very special."

Jack was amazed. He couldn't take his eyes off the painting! All around the museum he started to notice things that glowed in different colors. Everything was so beautiful.

Jack was so excited he couldn't contain himself. "Mommy, can we come back tomorrow and see all the things that glow?"

His mom smiled and said, "Yes, of course!" Jack smiled back and knew it was going to be the best day ever.

Once there was a baby. Her name was Lucy. She was very small and loved to eat. Everyday, she ate lots of food. One day, she was playing in the garden. It was a very wide garden full of flowers and trees.

Suddenly, she fell and hurt her knee. She started to cry. It hurt a lot. Her mom came running and picked Lucy up. She gave Lucy a big hug and kissed her knee. 

Lucy felt much better. But now she was very hungry. Her mom gave her some yummy food to eat. She ate it up quickly and felt much better. She touched her knee and it didn't hurt anymore. 

Lucy went back out into the wide garden, feeling happy and not scared of falling anymore. She was sure that her mom would always be there to take care of her.

Mia was running around, playing with her friends. Her mom yelled, "Mia, come over here for a second." Mia felt excited to hear her mom's voice. 

Mia ran over to her mom. She said, "Mom, what is it?"

Her mom replied, "I need to take you to get a haircut."

Mia felt sad and said, "No, I don't want a haircut. I like my hair long!"

Her mom tried to explain, "I know you like your hair long. But haircuts are good for your hair, and they feel yummy. Come on, let's go."

Mia knew her mom was right. She said, "Okay, I remember now."

Mia and her mom went together to the place to get the haircut. Mia was feeling a little scared. But after the haircut, Mia looked in the mirror and smiled. She loved the way her new hair looked. 

Mia and her mom came home from the haircut, and Mia never forgot how yummy the haircut felt.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very poor, and he didn't have many toys to play with. One day, Timmy's mom took him to the store to buy some ice cream. Timmy was so excited!

When they got home, Timmy's mom put the ice cream in the freezer. Timmy asked, "Can we eat it now?" His mom said, "No, we have to wait for it to freeze." Timmy didn't understand what that meant, so he asked his mom, "What does 'freeze' mean?" His mom explained, "It means the ice cream gets very cold and hard."

After a while, Timmy asked, "When will the freezing end?" His mom said, "Soon, don't worry." Finally, the freezing ended and they could eat the ice cream. Timmy was so happy! He said to his mom, "This is the best day ever!"

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to play in the water and splash around with his friends. One day, Ducky and his friends were playing in the pond when they saw a big exit sign. They decided to follow it and see where it led. 

As they waddled along, they noticed that the path was very organized with neat rows of flowers on either side. Ducky thought it looked very pretty. Finally, they came to a gate that led to a big field. Ducky and his friends were so excited to explore the new place. 

They ran around and played in the grass, but soon it was time to go back home. Ducky and his friends said goodbye to the new field and started to make their way back. As they passed by the pond again, Ducky couldn't resist one last splash before heading home for the day.

Once upon a time, there was a gray squirrel. He was a very cute squirrel and he was always blinking at the world around him. One day, he came across a tree full of nuts. He was so excited that he could hardly contain his excitement. He started to blink happily.

Suddenly, he heard a voice from up above. Looking up, he saw a small bird perched on the branch of the tree. It asked, "Hey there, little squirrel. What are you looking at?"

The squirrel stopped blinking and looked at the bird. He replied, "Oh, I just discovered this tree full of nuts. It looks delicious!"

The bird smiled and said, "I'll bet it does. Would you like me to help you eat them?"

The squirrel smiled and nodded. Together they ate all of the nuts until they were full. After they were finished, the squirrel thanked the bird and they said their goodbyes.

The squirrel blinked one last time and said, "Thank you for helping me. I had the best nut feast ever!" 

The bird smiled and said, "You're welcome. I'm so glad we could have this nut feast together." 

And with that, the squirrel scurried away, blinking happily.

Once upon a time, there was a big alligator. He lived in a clean, organized home near a pond. The alligator had many friends who liked to play with him.

One day, the alligator's friend, a small bird, needed help. The bird's nest had fallen from the tree. The alligator wanted to support his friend. So, he said, "Don't worry, bird. I will help you."

The alligator used his strong tail to lift the nest back up into the tree. The bird was very happy and thanked the alligator. "Thank you, alligator! You are a good friend."

From that day on, the alligator and the bird played together every day. They were best friends who always supported each other. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a fish named Bob wanted to design his home. He lived in a reef with his friends. Bob wanted his home to be original, so he asked his friends for help.

Bob asked his friend, Sally the sea star, "Can you help me make my home different?" Sally said, "Yes, we can use pretty shells and stones." They started to work on Bob's home together.

But then, a big shark came to the reef. The shark was very hungry and wanted to eat the fish. Bob and Sally were scared. They tried to hide in Bob's home, but the shark found them. The shark ate Bob and Sally. The other fish were sad because they lost their friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Lenny. He was three years old and was eager to complete any task his mom gave him.

One morning, she said, â€œLenny, today I want you to jog around the block. Then you can have your favorite ice cream for a treat.â€

Lenny got really excited. He put on his sneakers and started to jog in a normal way as fast as he could. Halfway through, he started to feel a bit tired, but he kept on going.

When he finally finished his jog, he saw his mom in the same spot where he had left her. She had a cone with the ice cream already waiting for him.

Lenny had completed the task and was happy. He ran to his mother and hugged her, grateful for the treat.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved ice cream cones more than anything else in the world. One day, Lily went to the ice cream store with her mom. She picked out a big cone with lots of flavors.

Lily was so excited to eat her cone, but she couldn't find a comfortable place to sit. She tried sitting on a bench, but it was too hard. She tried sitting on the grass, but it was too scratchy. Finally, she found a soft blanket to sit on.

When Lily took a bite of her cone, she realized it was too big for her mouth. She tried and tried but couldn't eat it all. But she didn't give up! She kept trying and finally succeeded in finishing her cone. And it was the best cone she had ever tasted!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved trains and he would always watch them go by. One day, Timmy saw a train that he really wanted to touch. He ran towards the train, but he tripped and hurt his knee. 

Timmy's mom came to help him and she brought him inside. She put a band-aid on his knee, but Timmy was still sad because he couldn't go see the train. His mom promised to bring him to see the train the next day. 

The next day, Timmy and his mom went to see the train. Timmy was so happy and excited, but he didn't listen to his mom when she told him to stay away from the tracks. Timmy got too close and the train hit him. Timmy's mom was very sad and hurt because she couldn't bring Timmy back. The end.

Once upon a time there was a valley deep in the forest. In this valley, there lived a helpful bird. 

One day, the bird heard a noise coming from the sky. The noise was clapping! Wonder who it could be he thought. 

He flew up into the air and saw a little girl clapping in delight. The bird floated around the girl in silence, watching. The girl smiled up at the bird and started to clap even louder. 

The bird was so happy that he started to clap back. The girl was so delighted that both of them clapped together. 

As the sun began to set, the bird said goodbye and flew away. He was thankful that he had a chance to meet such a helpful friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily and her family were going on a trip. They packed their luggage and drove to the airport. Lily was excited to go on an airplane for the first time.

When they arrived at the airport, they checked their luggage and went to the gate. But then they heard an announcement that their flight was delayed. Lily's parents were worried because they had a connecting flight to catch. They felt helpless and didn't know what to do.

Finally, their flight arrived, and they boarded the plane. Lily was happy to be on the airplane, but her parents were still worried about their connecting flight. When they arrived at their destination, they found out that they had missed their connecting flight. They were stranded at the airport with their luggage, feeling helpless. But then, a kind stranger arrived and helped them find a new flight. They were grateful for the stranger's help and happy to continue their trip.

Once upon a time there was a tiny ant. One hot day, she decided to march all the way to the beach. She wanted to go have some fun in the sand and cool off from the heat.

Along the way, she met a large elephant. He was very proud of himself and believed he was the most important creature in the world. But the ant kept marching on and was too humble to speak to him.

After a long march, the ant arrived at the beach. She was met with the soothing sound of the waves and the cool ocean breeze. She finally found the peace that the proud elephant had failed to find.

The ant learned a valuable lesson - it can take great strength to be humble. When the heat of life weighs you down, slow down, take a break and remember to stay humble.

Once there was a girl called Anna who was very tidy. She liked to clean and keep everything in order. But one day she forgot something important.

Anna had a horrible nightmare that night, but when she woke up she couldn't remember what it was. She was sad and scared because it was something she was afraid of.

Anna felt better when the sun came up and she decided to clean her room to help forget her nightmare. She tidied her toys and put everything in order. 

However, when Anna was finished she suddenly remembered what her nightmare was about. She had forgotten to close the window the night before and now there were bugs all over the floor. Anna was very sad and no amount of tidying could help her forget her nightmare.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Beth. She was three years old and loved nothing more than going for long walks. 
One day on a walk, Beth came across something that scared her. It was a dull and old looking house. 
Beth was scared of the house and ran away as quickly as she could. But when she got home she realised that she had left her teddy behind. 
So, Beth mustered up all her courage and went back to the house to look for teddy. She hesitantly opened the door and was surprised to find a big, friendly doggie! 
On hearing Beth, the pooch bounded over to her and licked her hand - she wasn't scared anymore. With the doggies help, Beth found her teddy and went outside to play.

The dull house was no longer scary to Beth and it became a fun and exciting place for her to explore.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the field near their house. The field has many flowers and trees and birds. Lily and Tom think the field is very pretty.

One day, Lily and Tom find a big sack in the field. They wonder what is inside the sack. They open the sack and see many toys. There are balls and dolls and cars and books. Lily and Tom are very happy. They say, "Wow, what a nice sack!"

Lily and Tom take out the toys and play with them. They throw the balls, hug the dolls, drive the cars and read the books. They have a lot of fun. They share the toys and say, "Thank you, thank you!"

But then, they hear a loud voice. It is the farmer who owns the field. He is angry. He says, "Hey, you kids, what are you doing with my sack? That is my sack of toys for my grandchildren. Give it back to me!"

Lily and Tom are scared. They did not know the sack belongs to the farmer. They say, "Sorry, sorry, we did not know. We just wanted to play. Please do not be mad at us."

The farmer sees that Lily and Tom are sorry. He is not so angry anymore. He says, "It is okay, I forgive you. But you should not take things that are not yours. That is not nice. Next time, ask before you play. And now, put the toys back in the sack and give it to me."

Lily and Tom do what the farmer says. They put the toys back in the sack and give it to him. They say, "Sorry again, farmer. We will not do it again. We hope your grandchildren like the toys. They are very nice toys."

The farmer smiles and says, "Thank you, kids. You are very polite. And you are right, the toys are very nice. My grandchildren will love them. And you know what? You can come and play in my field anytime. But only with my permission. And maybe, I will let you play with some of the toys too. How does that sound?"

Lily and Tom are happy. They say, "Thank you, farmer. That sounds great. We like your field. It is very pretty. And we like you too. You are very kind."

The farmer says, "You are welcome, kids. You are very sweet. Now, run along and have fun. But be careful and stay safe. And remember, always ask before you play."

Lily and Tom say, "Okay, farmer. We will remember. Goodbye, goodbye!"

They wave to the farmer and run back to their house. They are glad they made a new friend. And they are glad they learned a new lesson. They say, "We had a good day. We played with a nice sack. We saw a pretty field. And we met a kind farmer. We are lucky kids."

Henry was a gray mouse who lived in a big house. He was very happy and always smiled. One day, he went outside and saw a big cat. The cat looked very mean and silly. 

Henry said to the cat, "Hi! What are you doing?"
The cat didn't reply. He just stared at Henry.

Henry said, "Do you want to eat something?"
The cat just stared. 

Henry said, "I'm going to eat some cheese now, do you want some?" 
The cat just looked stupid and said nothing.

Henry realized the cat didn't want to talk, so he went back into his house and ate some cheese. Henry had a great time enjoying his cheese!

Once upon a time there was a stubborn little boy. He wanted to explore the world but his parents said no. One day, he heard a strange noise coming from outside. He wanted to go and see what it was, but he was scared and started to tremble.

His mama saw him. She asked him what was wrong. He looked at her and said he wanted to go outside. She said no but he was too curious. He went out of the house and saw a huge airplane flying in the sky. He was so amazed and forgot to be scared.

The airplane was from a faraway country. For a moment he forgot that the world was so big. He was so excited that he forgot to be stubborn and followed his parents back into the house.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who was very eager. He urged his dad to go on a walk together to a nearby park. His dad said yes, he was thoughtful and could see his son's enthusiasm. 

When they arrived at the park, they both played happily on the swing, the seesaw and the slides. But after a while, the boy's stomach started to grumble. He urged his dad to go home for dinner. His dad, being thoughtful, agreed and promised a bigger adventure tomorrow. 

When they arrived at home, delicious smells filled the entire house. The boy sniffed the air and urged his dad, "Let's have dinner!" His dad laughed and promised a big surprise, later. 

They both sat down at the table, and the boy's eyes widened when he saw what his dad had prepared. It was his favorite food! He thanked his dad for being so thoughtful.
