Once upon a time, there were two friends, Sally and Joe. They were both different, but they liked each other a lot. One day, Sally asked Joe to come to her house to play games.

When they got there, Sally showed Joe her new fan. It was so shiny and sharp, Joe was really impressed. He wanted to touch it and feel it, but Sally said he couldn't. Joe was disappointed, but he said okay.

But the next day, Joe's friend Tom came to his house to play games. Joe showed Tom his fan, and Tom was even more impressed than Joe. He asked Joe if he could touch it, too, and Joe said yes, he could! 

Sally was sad and angry that Joe let Tom touch her fan but not her. Sally was also hurt because she thought Joe was her best friend. 

So Sally and Joe had to have a talk about what friends should do. Finally, they both agreed that it's not nice to not let your friends touch something special to you. And from then on, Joe always gave Sally and all his friends a chance to touch his fan.

Once upon a time, there was a flower named Rose. Rose was very pretty, but she felt sad and lonely. Then one day, the sun shone down on her and she began to bloom. She opened her petals and felt so happy that she was able to bloom with the other flowers.

Rose started to learn about the truth of the world. She found out that patience was the key to finding joy. Gradually, she became less impatient, and more understanding of the things she couldn't control. 

Soon, it was time for Rose to bloom again! She opened her beautiful petals and stretched towards the sky. All the other flowers cheered for her accomplishment and she felt proud. Rose had learned that with patience, everything can bloom.

One day, Bob was walking through the forest, looking for adventure. Suddenly, he heard a loud call. Bob looked around, but he could not see anyone. Now he was really curious, and he followed the call until he found a humble bird.

The bird said, "Please help me, my eye is hurt!" Bob wanted to help, so he bent down to take a closer look. Just then, a lion came by and roared.

"Let's get out of here!" Bob said. He and the bird quickly ran away, but it was too late. The lion chased them and soon he caught the bird.

The lion devoured the bird and then growled at Bob. Bob was so scared that he ran away as fast as he could and never looked back. He would never forget this terrible ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park with her mommy. While they were walking, they saw a big peach tree. The peaches looked so yummy and clear. 

Lily said, "Mommy, can we get one peach?" 

Mommy replied, "We can't take the peaches from the tree. That's not nice. But we can buy some from the store." 

Suddenly, a little boy came up to them and said, "I want a peach too!" 

Lily said, "Sorry, we can't take the peaches. That's not nice." 

The little boy got upset and tried to pinch Lily. But Lily's mommy protected her and said, "No pinching! That's not nice either." 

The little boy felt bad and said sorry. Lily forgave him and they all went to the store to buy some yummy peaches. They all became friends and had a fun day in the park. The end.

Once there was a rabbit. He was lonely. He wanted someone to help him. He hopped around to different places, but no one helped him. He was so sad. 

One day, he went to the park. He met a cheetah. The cheetah asked the rabbit if he needed help. The rabbit said yes. 

The cheetah said he could help the rabbit. He said that he would use his speed to help the rabbit. The rabbit was so happy. 

The cheetah ran circles around the rabbit. The rabbit felt like he was going so fast too. Everywhere the rabbit needed to go, the cheetah would run ahead. 

He helped the rabbit find friends to play with, a place to live and food for the rabbit to eat. The rabbit was so thankful for the cheetah's help. The cheetah told the rabbit that he was never alone, and together they could do anything!

Once upon a time, there was a shy little elephant. Every day, he wanted to explore the world but he was too shy to try. One day, he decided to join the other animals in the jungle. He asked his friend, the monkey, to help him. 

The monkey said, "I recommend you use a cart for your journey. It will make it easier to explore the world." The elephant liked the idea and asked his mom to make him a cart. 

Mom was happy to help and built the cart with lots of decorations. She also put some treats inside so the elephant would not get hungry on his journey. 

The elephant was so excited and he thanked his mom. The next day, he hopped in his cart and began to explore the world with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a driver named Tim. Tim had a unique car that was very colorful. One day, Tim drove his car to the beach. When he arrived, he saw the waves and wanted to splash in the water. He ran to the water and started jumping up and down, splashing all around. It was so much fun! After he was done, he got back in his car and drove home. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to travel with his mommy and daddy. One day, they went to the airport and Timmy saw a big board with lots of names on it. "Look, mommy! That board has lots of names on it!" Timmy said. 

"Yes, Timmy. That board tells us which airplane to go on," mommy said. 

Suddenly, a grumpy man came up to them. "You're in my way. Move!" he said. 

Timmy felt sad because the grumpy man was mean. They got on the airplane and Timmy tried to make friends with the grumpy man, but he just grumbled. 

When they got off the airplane, they found out that their luggage was lost. Timmy was sad because he lost his favorite toy. The grumpy man just walked away without helping. Timmy felt very sad and wished the grumpy man was nicer.

Once upon a time there was a brave cat called Lucy. She had the most beautiful fur.

Every day Lucy's owner gave her some food to eat. Lucy loved her food and licked her lips in delight.

One day, Lucy saw a shock outside in the garden and she wanted to explore it. She was the bravest cat around; so she thought nothing of walking up to the shock.

But as she got closer, she saw a huge noisy machine. She jumped back and was so scared, her tail was shaking!

But then she heard a voice calling out. "Don't be afraid Lucy. It's ok, I'm here to feed you."

It was Lucy's owner and he was smiling. He reached out and stroked her head and told her to be brave.

He fed her until she was full and gave her a hug. Then he said,"Come on Lucy, let's go home."

And so Lucy and her owner went home, safe and sound. Lucy the brave cat knew that if she was ever in danger, her owner would always be there to protect her. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a child named Timmy. He loved to play with his toys and eat cookies. One day, Timmy's mommy took him to the store to buy more toys and cookies. They got in the car and Timmy's mommy started to drive. Timmy was happy at first, but then he got frustrated because the car ride was taking too long. Finally, they arrived at the store and Timmy was excited to see all the toys and cookies.

One day, a big dog named Spot and a small cat named Fluffy went to play outside. They ran and jumped in the green grass. They were very happy. But then, they saw a deep pit. They wanted to see what was inside.

Spot said, "I will jump in the pit and look." Fluffy was scared and shouted, "No, Spot! It is not safe!" But Spot jumped in the pit anyway. Fluffy was very sad and didn't know what to do.

Then, a useful bird named Blue flew by. Blue saw Fluffy crying and asked, "What is wrong, Fluffy?" Fluffy said, "Spot jumped in the pit and I can't get him out!" Blue said, "Don't worry, Fluffy. I will help you." Blue flew down into the pit and helped Spot out. Fluffy was so happy to see Spot again. They all played together and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wander around her backyard and explore. One day, she found a funny-looking plant with prickly needles. It was a cactus! Lily was very careful not to touch it.

Soon, her friends came over to play. They decided to have a race to see who could run the fastest. Lily was very competitive and wanted to win. But as they ran, she accidentally tripped and fell into the cactus! Ouch!

Lily's mom came to help her and carefully removed the needles. From then on, Lily learned to be more careful when she wandered around outside. And she realized that winning isn't everything - having fun with friends is more important.

John was very excited. He was going on a big adventure with his mom and dad. It was his first time going on a vacation and he couldn't wait! They were all packing their bags when they heard a loud yell in the distance. It was coming from the neighborhood park. They all looked out the window and saw a big thing flying across the sky. 

John was so excited that he yelled and ran out of the house. His mom and dad quickly followed after him. When they got to the park, they saw a big hot air balloon. John couldn't believe his eyes. He had never seen anything like it before. 

The balloon was bigger than all of them put together. Everyone around was standing back and pointing. The balloon flew over and suddenly stopped right in front of John. John was so excited that he almost couldn't contain himself. He wanted to touch it and get inside. 

His parents told him not to get too close, but John didn't listen. He ran up and touched the balloon. His mom and dad were scared, but John was ecstatic. He had just touched something amazing and he wasn't going to forget this anytime soon.

Once there was a seal swimming in the sea. He was a strong seal, and he loved to swim. He swam around and looked for food in the blue water.

Suddenly, he noticed a small boat. He watched it for a minute, and then he kept swimming. He kept exploring the deep ocean.

But then, he noticed something strange in the water. It was a big yellow fish! The seal was curious, so he swam closer to check it out. He was strong, and the fish didn't scare him.

Finally, the seal noticed something even stranger. It was another seal! He was surprised, but happy to see a friend. They swam together and played in the sea. They were happy and strong, and they had a great time.

Dog and Cat were best friends who did everything together. Every day they would get up and play in the garden.

One day, Dog looked over and saw something disgusting on the ground. He pointed and said, â€œWhatâ€™s that?â€ Cat looked over and said, â€œItâ€™s gross! Letâ€™s not go near it.â€

The next day when Dog and Cat woke up, they decided to play in the garden again. But when they got there, Dog saw the same disgusting thing. He asked Cat again, â€œWhatâ€™s that?â€ But this time Cat said nothing.

Suddenly, Dog felt angry. He pointed at the thing and shouted, â€œWhy did you bring this here!?â€ Cat looked embarrassed and said, â€œI wanted to show you something I found yesterday, but now itâ€™s all gross.â€

Dog was surprised and relieved. He smiled, saying, â€œWell, Iâ€™m glad it wasnâ€™t something bad.â€ Dog and Cat hugged and went back to playing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved the color pink and had a lucky teddy bear that she always kept with her. One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy and daddy.

At the park, Lily saw a big slide that she wanted to go on. But it was too high and she was scared. Her mommy said, "You can do it, Lily! Just hold on tight and you will manage to slide down safely."

Lily took a deep breath and climbed up the ladder. She held on tight to her lucky teddy bear and slid down the big slide. When she got to the bottom, she felt so happy and proud of herself. Her mommy and daddy clapped and said, "Good job, Lily! You are so brave and lucky to have your teddy bear with you."

Molly was very excited. She was going to have an elephant today! She had always wanted an elephant and today was finally the day. She quickly got dressed and ran outside with her mom.

When they got to the elephant, Molly was delighted. Her mom said that the elephant was very warm because it had just been taking a bath. Molly hugged the elephant and it felt very soft and warm.

The elephant was so happy to meet Molly and it gave her a giant hug. After that, Molly and the elephant went for a long walk in the forest together. They held hands and laughed and sang songs. 

At the end of the day, the two were very tired from their walk. Molly promised to visit her new friend the elephant every day. She said goodbye and waved until she and her mom could no longer see the elephant. 

Molly was so happy to finally have an elephant!

Once upon a time, there was a tiger who was lovely. Every day he would go on walks through the forest. One day, while he was walking, he saw something strange and out of the corner of his eye he saw a monster appear! The monster had huge teeth and sharp claws, but the tiger was brave and faced the monster. Suddenly, the monster said, "Don't be scared, I'm a friendly monster. I just want to be your friend!" The tiger was so surprised. He was scared of the monster, but now he realized the monster was nice. The two new friends talked and explored the forest together. They became the best of friends and the tiger was very happy to have a new friend. The tiger and the monster would always have lots of fun, and the tiger knew that he had found a companion he could love forever.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lily. She had a big sister named Clara who was very graceful. 

Every day Clara would ask Lily for help. She would say, "Lily please help me!"

Lily always replied, "Yes, I will help you!"

So, each day Lily and Clara worked together to get things done. Clara helped Lily learn how to do things in a graceful way. 

One day, Clara said to Lily, "Thank you for always being here for me. You make being graceful look so easy."

Lily smiled and replied, "I'm glad I can help my big sister." 

The two of them continued to work together and they learned that no matter what, they would always have each other's backs. They knew they could rely on each other with grace.

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to play in their room. They had many toys and books and games, but they also liked to try on their parents' clothes. They thought it was fun to wear big hats and coats and shoes and pretend to be different people.

One day, they found a key on the floor. They wondered what it could unlock. They looked around and saw a big trunk in the corner of the room. They had never opened it before. They decided to try the key on the trunk. It fit and they turned it. The trunk unlocked with a click.

They opened the trunk and saw many unusual clothes inside. They were colorful and shiny and had strange patterns and shapes. They were very different from the clothes they usually wore. They were curious and excited. They took out some of the clothes and put them on. They laughed and danced and made funny noises.

"Look at me, I'm a king!" Tim said, wearing a purple robe and a golden crown.

"And I'm a clown!" Sam said, wearing a red nose and a polka-dot suit.

They had so much fun that they did not hear their mom calling them for lunch. She came to their room and saw them in the unusual clothes. She was surprised and angry.

"Tim and Sam, what are you doing?" she asked. "These are not your clothes. These are your grandparents' clothes. They are very special and old. You should not play with them. You could damage them or lose them. They are part of our family history. You should respect them and put them back in the trunk. And you should not unlock things that are not yours. You should ask permission first. Do you understand?"

Tim and Sam felt ashamed and sorry. They realized they had done something wrong. They took off the unusual clothes and put them back in the trunk. They locked it and gave the key to their mom. They apologized and hugged her.

"We're sorry, mom. We didn't know. We were just curious and wanted to have fun. We won't do it again. We love you and we love our grandparents. Can you tell us more about them and their clothes?" they asked.

Their mom smiled and forgave them. She was glad they learned their lesson. She told them stories about their grandparents and their clothes. She explained why they were unusual and what they meant. She showed them pictures and souvenirs. She said they could look at them again, but only with her. Tim and Sam listened and asked questions. They felt happy and proud to know more about their family. They understood that some things are not for playing, but for remembering and honoring. They thanked their mom and gave her a kiss. They went to have lunch and then played with their own toys and clothes. They still had fun, but they also had respect.

Harry was excited. His best friend was coming over to play. His friend, Tim, brought his scooter. 

"Hi, Tim," Harry said. "Can I borrow your scooter?"

Tim thought for a moment.

"OK," Tim said. He smiled.

Harry grabbed the scooter and ran outside. He had so much fun scooting down the sidewalk.

Suddenly, a man came around the corner. His face was angry.

"Stop right there!" the man said. "That's my scooter!" 

Harry was scared. He hadn't meant to borrow someone else's scooter. 

"I'm sorry," Harry said. He gave the man back the scooter.

The man took the scooter and left.

Harry and Tim went back inside. 

"That was a close call," Tim said.

Harry nodded. He was glad to have his friend by his side. They played together the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a lion who lived in a big jungle. He liked to roar loudly to show that he was the king of the jungle. One day, he met a little girl who was playing a flute. The lion asked the little girl, "What is that noise?" The little girl answered, "It's my flute. Do you want to hear it?"

The lion said, "Yes, please." The little girl played her flute and the lion loved the sound. He said, "That was amazing! You play the flute so well. I wish I could play an instrument too." The little girl said, "Maybe you can try playing the flute." 

The lion tried to play the flute, but it didn't fit in his big mouth. He said, "Oh no, the flute is too small for me. I guess I'll just have to stick to roaring." The little girl said, "That's okay. Roaring is cool too." The lion smiled and roared happily. From that day on, the lion and the little girl became good friends and they would often play music and roar together in the jungle.

One day, Mommy and Alice went for a walk. Alice wanted to go to the park, but Mommy said it was time to leave. 

Alice started to cry. She wanted to stay at the park, but Mommy said it was time to leave. Alice was very unhappy. 

Mommy gave Alice a big hug. She said, "Come on, Alice. Let's leave. We can come to the park another day."

Alice pulled away and had a silly look on her face. She said, "But I want to stay here! You can't make me leave!" 

Mommy laughed and said, "We all have to leave sometimes. Come on, let's go." 

Alice pouted and took her Mommy's hand. They walked away from the park, with Alice looking back every few steps.

Once upon a time, there were two little friends, Jill and Jack.

One day, Jack opened up his cheese sack and saw it was empty. He was very sad and asked Jill, "Where did my cheese go?"

Jill felt a bit ashamed and said, "I ate it, I'm sorry." 

Jack was very surprised and said, "You ate it all? All of it?"

Jill hung her head low and said, "Yes, I ate it all."

Jack felt sad but gave Jill a hug and said, "It's okay, you don't need to feel ashamed. I forgive you." 

He took her hand and together they went off to get more cheese for Jack's cheese sack.

Lily and Ben are playing in the backyard. They pretend they are builders and they have a big hammer and some blocks. They want to make a house for their toys.

"Bang, bang, bang!" Lily says, hitting a block with the hammer. "This is the wall of our house. It is very strong."

"Bang, bang, bang!" Ben says, hitting another block. "This is the roof of our house. It is very high."

They work hard and make a lively house with many colors and shapes. They are happy and proud.

But then, Max, the big dog, comes running. He sees the house and thinks it is a toy. He jumps on it and knocks it down. The blocks fall and the hammer flies.

"Hey, stop!" Lily shouts. "That is our house! You are ruining it!"

"Bad dog!" Ben cries. "Go away! Leave our house alone!"

Max does not listen. He barks and wags his tail. He thinks they are playing with him. He grabs the hammer and runs away.

Lily and Ben are sad and angry. They look at their broken house and their missing hammer. They do not want to play with Max anymore. They want to make a new house. But how can they do it without a hammer?

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw with her pen. One day, she was going to her friend's house to play. She wanted to bring her pen with her to show her friend her drawings. 

Lily asked her mom, "Mommy, can you carry my pen for me? I don't want to lose it." 

Her mom replied, "Sure, I will keep it safe in my pocket." 

Lily was happy that her pen was safe with her mom. When they arrived at her friend's house, Lily showed her friend her drawings. Her friend loved them and they had so much fun playing together. 

At the end of the day, Lily's mom gave her back her pen. Lily was happy that her pen was safe and sound. She hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for carrying my pen for me!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to eat soup with her spoon. One day, Lily's mom made some soup for her and gave her a big spoon to eat with. Lily was so happy and started eating her soup.

Suddenly, Lily's little brother came and stood next to her. He wanted some soup too. But Lily didn't want to share her soup or her spoon with him. She said, "No, this is my soup and my spoon!"

Her little brother started crying and ran to their mom. He told her how Lily was being terrible and not sharing her soup and spoon. Lily's mom was very angry and scolded her. Lily felt very sad and sorry.

In the end, Lily realized that sharing is important and apologized to her little brother. But it was too late, her little brother had already fallen ill from hunger. Lily felt terrible and wished she had shared her soup and spoon with him.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Timmy and Tommy. They loved to play together, but one day they got into a fight. They were both very sad and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Timmy had an idea. He said to Tommy, "Let's unite and be friends again!" Tommy thought that was a great idea and they hugged each other. 

To remember this happy moment, they decided to take a picture. They found a pretty frame and put the picture inside. The frame was blue and had stars on it. 

Afterwards, they went to get some ice cream. It was a hot day and they were very thirsty. They drank some cold water and ate their ice cream. They were happy to be friends again and promised to never fight again. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a little dog called Pippy. Pippy lived with her best friend, a little girl named Jenna. Jenna loved to dress Pippy up in all sorts of silly costumes. Pippy always felt silly but she loved spending time with Jenna, so she put up with it. 

One day Jenna decided to put Pippy in a special Halloween costume. It had a big pumpkin head on it. Poor Pippy felt so stupid but she still followed Jenna around the park. 

Suddenly Jenna stopped and pointed to a big skeleton. Jenna said, "Look! That's a scary skeleton! I bet it's not very nice!" 

That's when Pippy noticed the skeleton was holding a big juicy bone. Pippy got so excited she forgot how silly she looked and ran over to the skeleton. She decided to try and chew the bone away from the skeleton. 

The skeleton was held together by magic and it wiggled back and forth trying to get away. Pippy chewed and chewed and eventually the bone came free! Jenna and Pippy laughed and ran off with the bone. 

They made it all the way back to the park before Pippy looked down at her costume and remembered how stupid she looked. But Jenna just smiled and said, "That's ok Pippy! You were brave and that's all that matters."

Once upon a time there was a village far away. It was a terrible place. The people who lived there had nothing to eat and were very sad. 

One day, a kind man came to the village. He said he wanted to help the people in the village. He offered them food, toys and clothes.

At first, the people were scared. They did not want to accept the kind man's help. But then one by one, they realized that he was nice and accepted his offer. 

The kind man kept coming back to the village every day. He did this for months and months. And slowly the terrible village transformed. It became a happy place, filled with smiles and laughter.

The kind man had brought so much joy and love to the village. The people were so thankful and grateful for his help. 

From then on, the people of the village accepted help from anyone who offered it. They knew that accepting kindness was the best way to live a happy life.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tommy who was very stubborn. One day, he wanted to pull his wagon, so he grabbed the handle. He pulled and pulled, but it wouldn't move. He used all of his strength, but he still couldn't move it.

Tommy pouted and shook his little fist. Then he had an idea! He put his finger under one of the wheels and he pulled with all of his might. This time, the wagon started to move! Tommy was so excited and he pulled the wagon all around the yard.

The big sun was so hot that Tommy started to get very tired. His little finger was very sore from all of the pulling, so he decided it was time to take a break. Tommy lay down in the grass, and soon he was fast asleep. 

The next morning, Tommy woke up and he was ready to pull the wagon again. He was still very stubborn, but with a little help from his friends he was able to finish his work. In the end, Tommy's stubbornness and strong finger helped him pull the wagon. And they all lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to ride the subway with her mommy. One day, they got on the subway and Lily saw a bright light. She pointed to it and said, "Mommy, look at the pretty light!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, it's very pretty."

As they rode the subway, Lily started to count the stops. "One, two, three," she said. Her mommy asked, "How many stops do we have left?" Lily counted and said, "Two more stops!"

Suddenly, a man on the subway said to Lily, "You're very good at counting! Can you count to ten?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, I can count to ten!" And she counted all the way to ten for the man. He clapped his hands and said, "Wow, you're very smart!" Lily felt very proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a brave girl who liked to try new things. One day she wanted to try something she had never tried before - spicy gum! 

She was a bit scared because she was unsure if the gum would taste too hot. But her mom encouraged her to have a try. So she went ahead and put the gum in her mouth. The gum was spicy, but not too hot!

The brave girl felt happy and proud. She tried something new and it was fun. Every day she kept on trying new things and her mom always encouraged her. 

The spicy gum became her favorite. She liked to chew it when she was feeling a bit nervous or scared. The spicy gum gave her courage and made her brave again.

And that's why it's important to encourage children to try new things - even something as simple as spicy gum.

Once upon a time, there was a pirate called Jack. He made his ship by the beach and he was very cheerful.

One day he was sailing his ship and he saw an island. He sailed to the island to explore and see what would happen.

When he arrived at the island he saw a big castle and he decided to go inside it. The castle was filled with friendly pirates and they were all very cheerful.

After exploring the castle he was about to return to his ship, when suddenly he accidentally stepped on a button and the door to a secret room opened. Inside the room were all kinds of wonderful pirate treasures.

Jack was very excited so he started filling up his ship with all the precious pirate treasures. Then he set off on his ship with a cheerful smile on his face. He had the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy's mommy asked him to go to the store to buy some gas for the car. Timmy was excited to help his mommy and he quickly went to the store.

At the store, Timmy met a friendly cashier. "Do you need help finding the gas?" the cashier asked. Timmy nodded his head and the cashier showed him where to find it. Timmy bought the gas and returned home to give it to his mommy.

"Thank you, Timmy! You are such a helpful young boy," said his mommy. Timmy felt proud of himself for being able to help his mommy. From that day on, Timmy always looked for ways to help others.

Lily was a very independent girl. She liked to do things by herself, without asking for help. She had a big box of toys in her room, and she loved to play with them. She had dolls, cars, blocks, and a shiny gold key.

One day, she decided to lock her door with the gold key. She thought it would be fun to have her own secret place, where no one could bother her. She turned the key in the lock and heard a click. Then she smiled and went to play with her toys.

But after a while, she got bored. She wanted to go outside and see her friends. She wanted to have a snack and a drink. She wanted to hug her mom and dad. She tried to open the door, but it was locked. She tried to turn the key, but it was stuck. She started to cry.

She heard a knock on the door. It was her mom. "Lily, are you okay? Why did you lock the door?" she asked.

"I wanted to be independent," Lily sobbed. "But now I can't get out. I'm sorry, mom. Please help me."

Her mom called her dad, and they got a tool to open the door. They hugged Lily and told her they loved her. They also told her that being independent is good, but sometimes you need to ask for help and share with others. Lily learned her lesson. She never locked her door again. She played with her toys, but also with her friends and family. She was happy and independent, but not alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot was very playful and loved to play with his toys. One day, Spot's owner took him to a big event in the park. There were lots of people and other dogs there, but Spot was having so much fun playing that he didn't even notice them. 

Suddenly, a loud noise disturbed Spot's playtime. It was a big truck driving by with lots of boxes on it. Spot didn't like the loud noise and started to bark. His owner picked him up and held him until the truck passed by. After that, Spot went back to playing with his toys and having fun. 

At the end of the day, Spot was tired from all the playing and excitement. He went home with his owner and fell asleep with his favorite toy in his mouth. The end.

Once upon a time, in a forest there was a little fox. The fox was very curious and one day, he decided to explore the forest. So the fox started walking and soon enough he came across a cave. Inside the cave, the fox spotted a big skull. He was so scared and quickly ran away. 

Meanwhile, an old owl was watching the fox. The owl asked the fox, "Why did you run away so quickly?" The fox replied, "I was scared because I saw a skull". The owl nodded and said, "It is ok to be scared but the skull has been there for a long time. It won't wake up". 

The fox felt relieved and thanked the owl for teaching him. From that day on, he remembered the owl's lesson to stay calm even when frightened. The fox also learnt to not judge something just by its appearance. From then on, the fox never felt guilty for running away from something that seemed scary.

Anna was sad. She wanted to play with her blocks, but they were on the table. The table was too high for her. She could not reach the blocks. She tried to climb on a chair, but she fell down. She hurt her knee. She began to weep.

"Anna, what is wrong?" Mama asked. She heard Anna's weep. She came to the room. She saw Anna on the floor. She saw the blocks on the table. She saw the chair on its side.

"I want my blocks!" Anna said. She wept louder. She pointed at the table.

Mama hugged Anna. She kissed her knee. She said, "I'm sorry, Anna. You should not climb on the chair. It is not safe. You could get hurt. You are a good girl. You can play with your blocks, but you need to ask for help."

Mama lifted Anna up. She put her on the table. She gave her the blocks. She said, "Here you go, Anna. You can play with your blocks on the table. The table is useful. It can hold your blocks. It can also hold your snacks and your books. But you need to be careful. You need to sit still. You need to listen to Mama. Can you do that?"

Anna nodded. She smiled. She said, "Thank you, Mama. I love you. I love my blocks. I love the table. I will be careful. I will listen to Mama." She stopped weeping. She started to build with her blocks. She was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little fly. The fly liked to shake its wings. It would shake, shake, shake all day long. The fly was very patient. It would wait for the perfect time to shake its wings.

One day, the fly met a big dog. The dog said, "Why do you shake your wings so much, little fly?" The fly replied, "I shake my wings because it makes me happy. I am patient and wait for the perfect time to shake them."

The dog thought about what the fly said. The dog decided to be patient too. It waited and waited for the perfect time to shake its tail. When the time was right, the dog shook its tail. It felt very happy just like the fly.

The fly and the dog became good friends. They would play and shake their wings and tail together. The other animals saw them and wanted to join in the fun. Soon, all the animals were shaking and being patient, waiting for the perfect time to shake.

And so, the little fly and the big dog taught everyone how to be patient and have fun. They all lived happily ever after, shaking and playing together in the warm sun.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant. He was very regular and liked to eat lots of leaves. One day, he was walking in the jungle when he saw a small bird. The bird was scared of the elephant, but the elephant said hello and didn't want to hurt the bird.

The bird was happy and started to sing a song. The elephant liked the song and started to dance. He moved his big body and the bird flew around him. They had a lot of fun together.

After a while, the bird said goodbye and flew away. The elephant was sad, but he knew he had to yield to the bird's wishes. He continued to walk in the jungle, looking for more friends to play with.

One day, a bird named Bella was very tired. She had been flying all day to find a friend. Bella stopped at a tree to rest. In the tree, she saw a nice squirrel named Sam.

"Hi, I am Bella. I like to sing. Do you want to be my friend?" asked Bella.

Sam smiled and said, "Yes, I would like that. My name is Sam."

Bella and Sam became good friends. They played and talked every day. One day, Sam told Bella about a big party. It was a marriage party for his friends, Mr. and Mrs. Rabbit. Bella was very excited.

At the marriage party, Bella sang a beautiful song. Everyone clapped and danced. Bella and Sam had a lot of fun. They were happy to be friends and share the special day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore. One day, she went to a stream to play with her friends. They had lots of fun splashing in the water and catching little fish.

But then, Lily's mom came to pick her up. She was embarrassed because she was all wet and her clothes were muddy. Her mom told her not to worry, and they went home to change.

Later that day, Lily decided to separate her toys into different piles. She put her dolls in one pile and her blocks in another. It made her feel happy and organized.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys and going on adventures. One day, Lily found a shiny diamond on the ground. It was so pretty and sparkly! She showed it to her mommy and daddy, and they were very happy for her.

But then, a funny thing happened. Lily's little brother came running and accidentally stepped on the diamond. Oh no! The diamond was destroyed! Lily was very sad, but her mommy and daddy told her that it's okay because they can always find another pretty thing to play with. And they all went on a fun adventure to find more treasures. The end.

Once there was a little boy. His hair was very long, and it was the color of brown leaves.

One day he was playing in the garden, when he heard a sound. It was very loud and he was scared. He hid in some bushes.

Peeking out, he saw a bear! The bear was big and black. The little boy was so scared he started to cry. But the bear didn't hurt him.

The bear said, "Don't be scared. You are okay. I just wanted to hear you laugh." The boy stopped crying.

He was ashamed he was scared. The little boy asked the bear why he wanted to hear him laugh. The bear said, "Those beautiful long hairs, they make me think of my little cub. When I saw them, I wanted to hear your laugh just like my cub." 

The little boy smiled. He was glad he wasn't scared any longer. They made a friend and laughed together all afternoon.

Once upon a time, there was a restless chicken. It loved to run around and explore, but one day it got stuck in a deep hole. The chicken was scared and wanted to get out, but the hole was too deep.

Suddenly, a kind farmer saw the chicken and came to the rescue! He used a long rope and climbed down deep into the hole. With one big swoop, he lifted the chicken and placed it back on the ground. The chicken was so happy to be out!

The farmer was glad that he could help the chicken. He watched as the chicken ran around and explored again, now that it was free. The farmer smiled and headed back home, knowing that he had saved the day.

Once there was a tomato. It was big and red and it was heavy. It fell out of the tree and landed on the ground. It made a "splat!" when it hit the ground. 

The tomato was mad. It had fallen so far and it didn't want to be there. So it started to roll away.

The tomato rolled and rolled, until it came to the garden. There were carrots and lettuce and other vegetables growing there. The heavy tomato rolled in and nestled up to all the other veggies.

The tomato wasn't so unhappy anymore. It liked being around all of its new friends. Since that day, it has enjoyed the garden and all of the other vegetables there.

Once there was a bear named Ben. He was very silly sometimes. One day, he wanted to have a muffin, so he decided to lie to get one from the shop. He put on a very clear voice and said to the shopkeeper: "I want a muffin". The shopkeeper felt suspicious so he said "No, that's not true, tell me the real reason why you wanted a muffin".

Ben was frustrated and didn't know what to do. He knew lying was wrong but he still wanted a muffin. He thought hard and finally he found a solution. He said to the shopkeeper "I want a muffin to share with my friend". The shopkeeper thought it was a good idea and Ben was happy because he finally got the muffin he wanted.

Moral of the story: It's good to be honest and never lie!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was only three years old, but she loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Lily was in the garden with her mom. She was running around and playing when she noticed a job. It looked like a very interesting job, so she went to take a closer look. It was a tiny bird's nest made out of twigs.

"Wow mama, look!" Lily said excitedly.

"That's a bird's nest Lily," her mom replied. "See how fragile it is? We need to be careful and not disturb it." 

Lily nodded, happy to learn something new. She felt proud of doing a good job to help the little birds. 

As Lily walked away, she couldn't help but notice how fragile the world around her was. She knew she had an important job to take care of the world and to keep it safe.

It was a bright and sunny day. Mommy and Johnnie were in the yard.

"Johnnie," said Mommy, "let's go for a drive in the vehicle." 
Johnnie was so excited! He loved the vehicle. 

Mommy started the vehicle and began to drive. They drove past lots of houses and trees. Then, they approached a tall bridge.

Johnnie was curious how the vehicle would make it across the bridge. "That's hard," said Johnnie.

"Don't worry, Johnnie," said Mommy. "Our vehicle is very smart."

And sure enough, the vehicle drove across the bridge with ease. Johnnie was so proud of the vehicle. He couldn't believe it was so smart!

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a little boy. The mommy was cooking in the kitchen. She was making something spicy. The little boy wanted to help, but he was too small. Suddenly, the little boy sneezed! The mommy laughed and said, "Bless you!" The little boy smiled and felt happy.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy who had a daughter. The daughter was very happy and loved to play with her toys. One day, the mommy and daddy told the daughter that they were going to take her to the park. The daughter was very excited and couldn't wait to go.

But then, the mommy and daddy had to delay the trip to the park because it started to rain. The daughter was sad because she wanted to go to the park so badly. The mommy and daddy promised that they would take her to the park as soon as the rain stopped.

After a while, the rain stopped and the mommy and daddy took the daughter to the park. But when they got there, they saw something weird. All the swings were missing! The daughter was confused and didn't understand why the swings were gone. The mommy and daddy explained that sometimes things can be weird and unexpected, but they can still have fun and play in other ways. And so, the daughter played on the slide and had a great time at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they found a big green structure to climb on. 

Lily's friend, Timmy, said "Be careful, the edges are sharp!" 

Lily replied, "Don't worry, I'll be careful." She climbed up the structure and looked down at Timmy. "I can see everything from up here!" 

Timmy smiled and said, "Wow, you're so brave!" 

Lily felt proud of herself and they continued to play on the green structure for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Ella. Ella was very curious and she loved exploring.

One day she went to her school and she saw a damaged blackboard near the entrance. She walked up to it and she looked around carefully.

Ella noticed that it was broken and so she wanted to repair it. She asked her teacher for help and her teacher said,
"That's an interesting challenge. Do you think you can fix it?"

Ella nodded eagerly and she got to work. She went looking for the tools she needed and eventually she managed to repair the blackboard.

"Wow, Ella. You did a great job!", her teacher said.

Ella smiled proudly. She was glad to see the blackboard fixed. It was such an interesting adventure!

Once, there were two friends named Andy and Rosy. They were best friends and promised to always stay together. One day, they went to the movies. It was incredible! They watched a funny film and the time flew by. 

When they left the theater, they asked their parents if they could watch movies together all the time. To their surprise, their parents promised to take them to the movies every weekend. Andy and Rosy were happy.

They kept their promise and went to the movies every weekend. They saw more incredible films and laughed out loud. At the end of each movie, they hugged each other tightly and promised never to forget their fun times together. They kept their promise and they are still best friends today.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to look at nature. She would go to the park every day and wonder at the plants. She saw so many kinds of plants in all sorts of colors. Her favorite was a pink one.

The girl wanted to have a pink plant of her own. She asked her mom to help her get one for her bedroom. Her mom was so happy that she went right away to look for one.

Soon, the girl had a pink plant in her bedroom. She watered it every day and it grew bigger and bigger. The girl was so excited to watch it grow.

She kept wondering if her pink plant would ever bloom. Soon, one day it began to produce some beautiful pink flowers. The girl was so happy!

She was so excited to show off her pink plant to all her friends. The girl was so proud of her pink plant. Every day she would take care of it and it kept blooming more and more.

Lily was very happy. She had a new friend at school. His name was Tom. He liked to play with cars and blocks. Lily liked to play with dolls and books. They had fun together.

One day, Lily invited Tom to her house. She wanted to show him her toys and her cat. Tom said yes. He was excited. He liked Lily's house. It was big and pretty.

Lily's mom was very nice. She said welcome to Tom. She gave him a mug of milk and a cookie. Tom said thank you. He drank the milk and ate the cookie. They were yummy.

Lily and Tom went to Lily's room. They played with her toys and her cat. They laughed and talked. They had a lot of fun.

But then, something terrible happened. Lily's cat knocked over the mug of milk. The milk spilled on the floor and on Tom's pants. Tom was wet and sticky. He felt sad and angry. He cried.

Lily was sorry. She said sorry to Tom. She said sorry to her mom. She said sorry to her cat. She wanted to make Tom happy again.

Lily's mom was kind. She said it was okay. She said it was an accident. She said she would clean the floor and Tom's pants. She said she would give Tom another mug of milk and another cookie.

Lily hugged Tom. She said she was still his friend. She said she still liked him. She said they could still play.

Tom smiled. He said he was still her friend. He said he still liked her. He said they could still play.

Lily and Tom were happy again. They played with her toys and her cat. They drank the milk and ate the cookie. They had fun together.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady who loved oranges. She would count them every day to make sure she had enough. One day, a little boy came to her house and saw all the oranges. He asked, "Why do you have so many oranges?"

The elderly lady replied, "I love oranges. They are sweet and juicy. I like to count them every day."

The little boy asked, "Can I count them too?"

The elderly lady smiled and said, "Of course, you can count them with me."

So, the little boy and the elderly lady counted all the oranges together. They had so much fun that the little boy came back every day to count oranges with the elderly lady. They became good friends and enjoyed each other's company.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sarah wanted to visit her grandpa. She asked her mom if they could go on an adventure, and her mom said yes.

They got in the car and drove for a long time. As they drove, Sarah noticed the ground shaking. She asked her mom what it was, and her mom told her that it was an earthquake.

The car stopped in front of a big house. Sarah was so excited to see her grandpa. She knocked on the door and Grandpa opened it. His voice was soft and kind. He welcomed Sarah with a big hug.

They went inside, and Sarah couldn't believe how cozy it was. She saw a big kitchen and a soft bed. She played there with her grandpa all day, until it was time to go home. 

Before they left, Sarah gave her grandpa a big hug. It was the best visit ever!

Mama and Max were in the kitchen. Max saw something in the bowl. He ran to Mama and shouted "What is this?"

Mama smiled and said, "Max, it's sugar. I am going to add it to the cake. We will make it sweet!"

Max nodded and asked, "Can I help?" Mama agreed and gave Max a spoon.

Max scooped up some sugar and dropped it into the cake mix. Mama said, "Max, you need to stir it all together. Then it will be yummy!" 
Max grabbed the spoon and mixed the ingredients. When he was done, Mama smiled and said, "Good job, Max! Now it's time to taste it."

Max opened his mouth and tasted the cake. He smiled and said, "It tastes different!"

Mama nodded and said, "Yes, now it tastes sweet." Max smiled and said, "I like it!"

Once upon a time, there was a little kitten. She was very cute and fluffy. One day, she went outside to play. She saw a butterfly and tried to catch it, but it flew away. 

Then, she saw a little girl walking by. The little girl saw the kitten and said, "Oh, you are so lucky to be so cute!" The kitten didn't understand what the little girl meant, but she was happy to be called cute. 

Suddenly, the little girl took out a box of toys. She showed the kitten a ball and said, "Let's play catch!" The kitten didn't know how to play catch, but she tried her best. She jumped and chased the ball until she finally caught it. The little girl clapped her hands and said, "You did it! We match so well!" The kitten didn't know what "match" meant, but she was happy to play with her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little puppy named Max. He loved to play outside in the snow. One day, while Max was playing, he saw a big, scary cat. The cat didn't like Max and wanted to hurt him. Max got very scared and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Max remembered that he had a special power. He could freeze! Max closed his eyes and focused very hard. Then, he froze in place. The cat couldn't see him and walked away. Max was safe! 

After that day, Max realized that he had a special gift. He could use it to protect himself and others. He decided to use his gift for good and always be a helpful friend. Max learned that being adorable was not enough to keep him safe, but with his special power, he could overcome any danger.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and dolls. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she wanted to have a fancy tea party with her dolls. Lily was very excited and said yes.

Lily's mom provided all the things they needed for the tea party. She brought out the tea cups, saucers, and a fancy teapot. They sat down and enjoyed their tea and cookies.

Suddenly, Lily saw some smoke coming from the kitchen. She got scared and ran to her mom. Her mom told her not to worry and that she would take care of it. She quickly put out the fire and everything was okay.

After the tea party, Lily's mom told her that it's important to always be careful with fire and to never play with matches or lighters. Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom and always be safe.

Lily was a spoiled girl who always wanted new toys. She did not like to share or play with her old toys. She only wanted the toys that she saw on TV or in the store. One day, she saw a big, shiny car that could seat four dolls. She asked her mom to buy it for her, but her mom said no. It was too expensive and Lily had enough toys already.

Lily was very angry and sad. She cried and screamed and threw a tantrum. She did not listen to her mom or say sorry. She ran to her room and slammed the door. She looked at her toys and hated them. She wished she had the big, shiny car.

The next day, Lily's mom had to go to work at the factory. She made clothes and shoes for other people. She asked Lily to come with her, because she could not find a babysitter. Lily did not want to go, but she had no choice. She put on her coat and shoes and followed her mom.

At the factory, Lily saw many machines and people working hard. They were noisy and busy and dirty. Lily did not like it. She wanted to go home and play with her toys. She told her mom that she was bored and hungry and tired. Her mom said that she had to work for a few hours and then they could go home. She gave Lily a sandwich and a juice and told her to seat on a chair and be quiet.

Lily ate her sandwich and drank her juice, but she was still bored. She looked around and saw a big pile of boxes. She wondered what was inside them. She got up from her chair and walked to the boxes. She opened one and saw a big, shiny car that could seat four dolls. It was the same car that she wanted. She was very happy and excited. She took the car out of the box and put it on the floor. She found four dolls in another box and put them in the car. She pretended that she was driving the car and having fun. She did not care that the boxes and the car and the dolls belonged to the factory and not to her. She did not care that she was being naughty and selfish. She only cared about the car.

Once upon a time, there was a horse named Lucky. Lucky lived in a stable with his friends. The stable was big and had lots of hay to eat. One day, Lucky decided to race his friends. He ran very fast and won the race! Lucky was so happy to win.

But then, Lucky heard a scary noise. He looked around and saw a big, scary cat. Lucky was scared and didn't know what to do. But then, Lucky remembered he was a brave horse. He kicked his legs and chased the cat away. Lucky felt very proud and happy that he saved his friends from the scary cat.

Once upon a time there was an old man. He used to be strong and full of energy, but now he was very weak. He used to love to play in the garden, but now it was too hard for him to move. 

The old man was very sad. He not only felt tired and lonely, but he suffered greatly. Every day he looked around and saw other people playing and having fun, but he couldn't do the same.

One day, the old man found a disgusting old bug. He was so surprised and scared by it, he said "Hello old creepy bug - why you here?"

The old bug said, "I suffer too, just like you. Look around, there is suffering everywhere. We must try to be kind to each other, even when it is hard." 

The old man was very thankful for the old bug's wise words. They said goodbye and the old man went away feeling much happier than before.

Once upon a time, there was a bouncy kitten called Lucy who lived with her mom and dad in a cozy house. Every day, Lucy would go out and wander in the sunshine, looking for fun.

One day, when she was out exploring, she spotted something glinting in the grass. She went over to take a look and saw that it was a hoop! It was made of shiny metal and it made Lucy feel so excited.

She picked up the hoop and started to play with it, rolling it around and hopping over it too. She wiggled and jiggled and had the best time ever.

Nearby, her mom was watching and called out, "Lucy, come here! What's that you have there?"

Lucy proudly held up the hoop and announced, "Look! I found this hoop and it's so playful!"

Her mom smiled and said, "Yes it is. You can keep it and play with it whenever you want."

After that, Lucy was always seen wandering with her hoop, playing and having lots of fun. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old and so curious about the world. One day Jane wanted to learn about the tiny things all around her, so she asked her mom to get her a microscope.

When the microscope arrived, Jane was so excited and ran to her room to look through it. But when she turned it on, loud noises and flashing lights came out of it. Jane panicked and didn't know what to do. 

Luckily, Jane's mom heard the loud noises and came to her rescue. She quickly turned off the microscope and explained how to use it safely and correctly. Jane was happy because now she could learn about all the tiny things in the world.

The next day Jane used her microscope and was amazed by what she saw. She felt so lucky to have her mom who helped her when she panicked and taught her how to use the microscope.

Granny was writing in a big book. She had a picture of a soldier on the page and she was writing with a cold pencil. She said, "The soldier is very brave!" 
Then Granny wrote something else in the book. She wrote, "He is a brave soldier". 
After Granny finished writing, she said, "The soldier is very strong and he is good at fighting." 
Suddenly the door opened and Granny's grandson, Tim, came in. He said, "Granny, what are you writing about?" 
Granny said, "I'm writing about a brave soldier. He is strong and he fights for his country." Tim asked, "Do soldiers get cold?" Granny smiled and said, "Yes, sometimes they can get cold." 

Tim nodded as if he understood and he said, "I want to be a brave soldier when I get bigger!" Granny smiled and said, "That would be wonderful!"

Kara was a happy three year old. She loved to play with her toys, especially her big, red car. One day, she wanted to take it for a spin. She was so excited that she shoved it to the top of the slide. Kara climbed the slide, shouted "weee", and slid down.

Suddenly, the car slipped out of her hands and started to roll away. Kara watched from the top of the slide, feeling helpless. 

As the car made its way down the hill, finally came to a stop. Kara got off the slide and ran towards it, relieved to find it safe. 

But then, to her surprise, the car started rolling again. She chased after it, but the car kept rolling faster and faster. 

Kara started to feel even more helpless. But before the car could get away, a gleaming white car drove up and blocked its path. An old man stepped out of the car, bent down and picked it up. He smiled at Kara and said, "There you go, little one."

Kara thanked the man and accepted her car. She ran back home, feeling thankful and no longer helpless.

Tom is a boy who likes to play with cars. He has many cars of different colors and sizes. He likes to make them zoom and crash on the floor. He also likes to go to the shop with his mom and dad. The shop has many things to see and buy. Tom likes to look at the toys and the books and the candy.

Tom is glad and says, "Yes, you can play with me. Let's go to the wide space over there. We can make a race and see who is the fastest." He invites them to follow him to the wide space. They count to three and then push their cars as hard as they can. The cars zoom and whizz and race. Tom, Lily and Ben cheer and laugh. They have a lot of fun playing with cars at the shop.

John was playing catch with his dad. He threw the baseball and it landed deep in the grass. His dad said, "You need to run and get it, John."
John said, "But Daddy, it's too far away."
His dad said, "Nothing is too far away when you try. Please go get it."

John was scared. He did not want to get close to the deep grass. But his dad showed him how to count to three and said, "One, two... three - go!"

John ran and found the baseball. He couldn't believe it! He was so proud and showed it to his dad with a big smile. His dad patted him on the head and said, "Good job, John. Everything is possible if you try."

John and his dad continued playing catch. This time, John threw the ball even farther away and ran to get it. His dad said, "That's great! Anything is possible if you believe and try."

Once there was a little farmer who had a grumpy cow. The cow didn't like to eat the grass in the farmer's field. The farmer felt bad for the cow, so he decided to restore the grass and make it look nice again.

The farmer got to work and began to cut down the old grass and plant new ones. After a few days the farmer was finished. The grass looked so lively and green, it made the farmer very happy.

The cow was also happy when it saw the new grass. She was no longer grumpy when she ate the fresh and tasty grass.

Everyday the farmer and his cow would go for long walks in the now restored field. They were both very happy and healthy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a smelly dog named Max. Max liked to follow people and make friends. One day, Max saw a big building called a university. He wanted to go inside and see what was there.

Max walked through the door and saw many people. He started to follow a nice girl named Sue. Sue looked down and said, "Hi, smelly dog! What are you doing here?" Max wagged his tail and followed Sue into a big room with lots of chairs.

Sue sat down and Max sat next to her. They listened to a man talk about fun things. After the talk, Sue said, "Max, you are a good friend. Let's go outside and play!" Max and Sue went outside and played until the sun went down. They were very happy and had a great day at the university.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the zoo with her mommy and daddy. One day, when they went to see the zebras, Lily saw a unique zebra that was all white with black stripes. 

Lily said to her mommy, "Look at that zebra! It's so different from the others!" 

Her mommy replied, "Yes, it's very unique. Let's go fill up its water bucket." 

Lily and her mommy went to get some water and filled up the zebra's bucket. The zebra was very happy and said, "Thank you!" in zebra language. 

Lily was so excited that she got to help the zebra. She said to her mommy, "I love coming to the zoo and helping the animals." Her mommy smiled and said, "Me too, Lily. Let's go see what other animals we can help today." And so, they went off to explore the rest of the zoo.

Once there was a big pool. The water was shiny and one day a bell began to ring. Everyone was so excited because it meant that it was time to have fun.

The children ran to the pool and dashed in. They laughed and splashed around in the big pool. One of the kids found a big floaty and floated around for a while. Then they started playing games like diving for toys and having races.

When the bell rang again, it was time to get out and dry off. Everyone was so tired from the fun they had been having. They dried off know that they had had a great time in the big pool.

Jack was a very sleepy little boy. He was three years old and loved playing games. One day he was walking near a big oak tree. It was tall and strong. Jack wanted to play a game to repair the tree.

He gathered some mud, twigs, and leaves. He mixed the mud with water and used it to make a glue. He stuck the twigs and leaves onto the oak tree. When he was done, the tree was fixed.

Jack smiled and was happy. The oak tree was his proud repair job. He saw it standing tall again and was happy he helped it. He hugged the oak tree and said "There, now you're good as new!" 

The oak tree thanked Jack and the little boy went back home. He was very tired from his repair job and quickly fell into a deep and sleepy slumber.

Lila and Tom were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they found a big pile of pebbles near the river. They decided to make a game with them. They each took some pebbles and threw them into the water, trying to make the biggest splash.

"Look, I found a shiny pebble!" Lila said, holding up a smooth, black stone. "It looks like a star!"

"Let me see!" Tom said, reaching for the pebble. "Maybe it has magic!"

Lila did not want to share. She hid the pebble in her pocket and ran away. Tom was angry and chased her. They ran and ran, until they came to a dark forest.

"Stop, Lila!" Tom shouted. "Give me the pebble!"

"No, it's mine!" Lila shouted back. "Go away!"

They did not see the big bear that was sleeping behind a tree. The bear heard their noise and woke up. He was hungry and angry. He saw the two children and roared.

Lila and Tom were scared. They tried to run away, but the bear was faster. He caught them and ate them. The pebble fell out of Lila's pocket and rolled into the river. It was gone.

The moral of the story is: Do not be greedy and selfish. Share with your brother or sister. And do not disturb a sleeping bear.

Once upon a time, there was a fireman named Jack. Jack was always very hungry because he worked hard to put out fires. One day, Jack was eating his lunch when a little boy came up to him and asked, "Can I add some ketchup to your sandwich?"

Jack said, "Sure, that would be great!" The little boy added ketchup to Jack's sandwich and they started talking. The little boy said, "I want to be a fireman like you when I grow up."

Jack smiled and said, "That's great! We need more firemen to help keep people safe."

Later that day, Jack got a call that there was a big fire at a nearby building. He rushed over to help, but unfortunately, he didn't make it out. The little boy was sad when he heard the news, but he knew that Jack was a hero who had helped many people.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park. She wore a pretty dress and a pink belt around her waist. She saw a boy playing with a ball and went to talk to him. 

"Hi, my name is Lily. What's your name?" she asked the boy.

"My name is Max. Do you want to play with me?" Max replied.

Lily nodded and they started playing together. They had so much fun that they both laughed and ran around lively. After a while, Lily's mom called her to go home. 

"I had so much fun playing with you, Max. Let's play again tomorrow!" Lily said.

"Sure, I'll see you tomorrow!" Max replied.

Lily went home happy and told her mom all about her new friend Max.

The bug wanted to help the other creatures in the garden so he came up with a plan. He decided to remain in the same spot so others could find him. He sang his song really loudly, so that everybody could hear him. 

One day, a baby bird in the garden heard the bugâ€™s song and became very happy, because she remembered that song. She called all her friends and they flew towards the bug because they wanted to meet him. 

The bug was so helpful and was really happy that his song was useful and he made many new friends. The bug, the baby bird and all their friends had so much fun together and sang the same song all day long!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lizzy. She was three years old and very excited for a big adventure. She had never been on a train before, so today was a very special day. When she arrived at the station, she gasped in amazement at how big it was. She waved goodbye to her mom and dad as they watched her board the train.

The conductor gave her a friendly smile and asked her where she was going. She smiled back, full of excitement, and told him she was going on an adventure. He nodded with a smile and left.

Lizzy watched the countryside pass by through the windows. Everywhere she looked, she saw something that took her breath away; a fresh lake surrounded with tall trees, a meadow with wildflowers, a small pond with ducks swimming. It was all so amazing. 

After a while, she got tired and decided to take a nap. She snuggled up in her seat and soon enough, she was sleeping. But then, something happened. The train screeched and Lizzy woke up with a start. She looked around and saw that the train had stopped at a station. She sighed in disappointment, for she had missed going on her adventure. 

That day, Lizzy learned her lesson: Donâ€™t miss an adventure by taking too long of a nap.

Once upon a time, in a land of sand, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toy cars in the sand. He had many different cars, some were big and some were small. Tim's favorite car was a bright red one that went very fast.

One day, while Tim was playing, he saw a little girl named Sue. Sue had a pretty doll. Tim wanted to play with Sue and her doll, so he went to her and made a request. "Can I play with your doll, please?" he asked. Sue said yes, and they both played together in the sand.

As they played, Tim and Sue found out that they liked the same things. They liked to make sand castles, play with their toys, and run around. They became good friends and played together every day. Tim and Sue learned that even if they had different toys, they could still have lots of fun together.
